definition_zh: 卷轴；卷盘；一卷（电影胶片）；蹒跚；感到震惊而发懵；收起（钓线）；纺车
definition_en: a round spool on which film, fishing line, or thread is wound; also, to move unsteadily or to be left stunned
core_image: 一圈线通过卷盘不断绕紧又放出，最后把人绕得站立不稳
scene: 他从炸毁的录像厅里走出来，步子不稳。He reeled away from the ruined cinema, dizzy and shaking.
sceneCN: 这里 reel 是「蹒跚、踉跄」（第 4 个义项：脚步不稳地走动）；句意：他从被炸毁的电影院里踉跄退出，又晕又抖。

derivatives.zh: 可卷绕的：reel + -able（能够……的）
卷线者；卷绕工：reel + -er（做……的人）
蹒跚行走的人或动物（苏格兰与北英格兰用法）：reel + -er，由「蹒跚」义派生

senses.title: A round spool for winding
senses.definition: a cylinder with a raised edge on which thread, wire, or film is wound
senses.definitionCN: 边缘凸起、用来缠绕线、铁丝或胶片的圆筒
senses.example: She wound the bright silk onto a wooden reel.
senses.exampleCN: 她把亮色丝线绕到木制卷轴上。
senses.why: The oldest sense is the physical body that any other use of the word needs, because without a spool nothing can be wound.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是那个实体器物，其他用法都离不开它，因为没有了卷盘就什么都绕不起来。

senses.title: A quantity wound on a spool
senses.definition: the amount of film or thread that one spool holds, used as a unit of length
senses.definitionCN: 一个卷盘所能容纳的胶片或线的量，用作长度单位
senses.example: The documentary was shot on ten reels of film.
senses.exampleCN: 这部纪录片拍了十卷胶片。
senses.why: A full spool becomes a measure, so the container turns into the quantity it holds.
senses.whyCN: 装满的卷盘被当成一种度量，于是容器本身变成了它所承载的量。

senses.title: A machine part for winding
senses.definition: a spool fitted to a mechanism, such as a fishing rod, that winds and lets out line
senses.definitionCN: 装在钓竿等机械装置上、用来收放线轴的部件
senses.example: Turn the reel slowly to bring the line back in.
senses.exampleCN: 慢慢转动卷线器，把线收回来。
senses.why: Once the spool is mounted on a rod it acts as a tool, so the noun narrows to fishing and weaving equipment.
senses.whyCN: 当卷盘被装到钓竿上，它就成了一样工具，因此这个词逐步专指钓鱼与纺织器具。

senses.title: To move unsteadily
senses.definition: to walk or move with an unsteady, swaying motion as if about to fall
senses.definitionCN: 像快要摔倒那样摇摇晃晃地走、移动
senses.example: He reeled backwards when the ball hit him.
senses.exampleCN: 球打中他时，他向后踉跄了一下。
senses.why: The image of something spinning on a spool gives the movement sense: a person turns round and round and loses their balance.
senses.whyCN: 绕在卷盘上的东西不停旋转，于是产生了「走动」义：人也像绕圈一样转，失去平衡。

senses.title: To be left stunned
senses.definition: to be very shocked by news or an event and unable to think or react normally
senses.definitionCN: 因消息或事件极度震惊，无法正常思考或反应
senses.example: The town was still reeling from the flood.
senses.exampleCN: 这座镇子仍因那场洪水而惊魂未定。
senses.why: The steady, unsteady movement is borrowed for the mind: when the ground seems to spin, the senses reel.
senses.whyCN: 身体的不稳被借用到头脑上：当脚下仿佛转圈时，人就发懵了。

senses.title: To wind in or out
senses.definition: to wind thread, wire, or a fishing line onto a reel, or to pull something in by so doing
senses.definitionCN: 把线、铁丝或钓线绕到卷轴上，或借此把某物拉回来
senses.example: She reeled in the line with both hands.
senses.exampleCN: 她用双手收线。
senses.why: The noun becomes a verb, and the action of winding is named by the spool that performs it.
senses.whyCN: 名词转成动词，把「缠绕」这个动作直接用完成的卷盘来命名。

intro.en: Reel is usually traced to an Old English word for a spool or winding device; the precise early form and its deeper source are uncertain.
intro.cn: reel 一般认为来自古英语中表示「卷线器」的词；其早期确切的词形与更早来源尚不确定。

items.en: The deeper origin of the spool word is not settled by scholars.
items.cn: 表示卷盘的那个词更深的来源，学界尚无定论。

items.en: An Old English word names a device for winding yarn, and the modern form is generally seen as its descendant.
items.cn: 古英语中有一个词指绕纱的器具，一般认为现代英语形式由它演变而来。

items.en: Reel is recorded as a spool and, by the end of the period, as a dance with a turning motion.
items.cn: 中古英语时期 reel 记录为卷轴，并在末期出现指「旋转的舞蹈」的用法。

items.en: From the spinning spool comes the verb meaning to go round unsteadily.
items.cn: 由旋转的卷盘引申出「摇晃打转地走」这个动词义。

items.en: Photography and film give reel its sense of a length of pictures on a spool.
items.cn: 摄影与电影让 reel 获得「一卷影像胶片」的含义。

items.en: The stunned sense develops alongside the physical one and becomes very common in news writing.
items.cn: 「震惊发懵」的义项与实义并行发展，并在新闻写作中变得极常用。

note.en: Reel sits with word family members such as reeling, and with other spool and stagger words.
note.cn: reel 与 reeling 等同族词相邻，也与「线轴」「摇晃」这一类词相关。

entries.definitionCN: reel 的现在分词

entries.definitionCN: 盘式的，指磁带从一个卷盘绕到另一个卷盘的录音机

entries.definition: a cylinder on which thread or wire is wound
entries.definitionCN: 线轴；卷轴

entries.definition: to walk unsteadily as if about to fall
entries.definitionCN: 摇晃地走；踉跄

entries.definition: to unwind something from a spool
entries.definitionCN: 从卷轴上放出（线、带子）

normalIntro.en: Reel is one shape doing several jobs: a round spool that winds, and the turning motion that makes people sway.
normalIntro.cn: reel 是同一个「绕圈」的画面在做几件事：绕线的圆盘，以及使人摇晃的旋转。

normal.en: The noun reel is the spool; the verb reel adds the spelling -ed for its past tense.
normal.cn: 名词 reel 就是卷盘；动词 reel 的过去式加 -ed 变成 reeled。

normal.en: Fishing use gives us reel in, meaning to pull the line and the fish back.
normal.cn: 钓鱼用法给出 reel in，意为把线连同鱼一起拉回来。

normal.en: The idiom off the reel came from cloth spun quickly and means doing something without stopping.
normal.cn: 习语 off the reel 来自快速纺布的场面，意为不间断地做某事。

normal.en: In film work a reel is a length of film, so a reel review collects short clips.
normal.cn: 在电影行业里 reel 指一段胶片，所以 reel review 意为「短片集锦回顾」。

normal.en: Compare reel with spool: the first tends to be the film or fishing kind, the second a general thread holder.
normal.cn: 对比 reel 与 spool：前者多指胶片或钓鱼用的，后者泛指缠线的轴。

abstract.en: Picture a wooden spool with dark thread turning as a hand pulls it.
abstract.cn: 想象一个木制线轴，深色线在手里越拉越快。

abstract.en: Imagine a glowing film strip running through a projector and landing on the next spool.
abstract.cn: 想象一条发亮的胶片穿过放映机，落进下一个卷盘。

abstract.en: Think of a fishing line singing out and then coming back in fast.
abstract.cn: 想一想钓线先是飞快放出，又迅速收回的画面。

examples.en: The projectionist changed the reel halfway through the film.
examples.cn: 放映员在影片放到一半时换了胶片卷。

examples.en: He reeled in his line and showed us the small silver fish.
examples.cn: 他收起钓线，把那条银色小鱼给我们看。

examples.en: The team was reeling after losing the final in the last minute.
examples.cn: 球队在最后一分钟输掉决赛后，全都懵了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞欧」——想象一只转轮到得很快，把线绕得瑞瑞欧欧响，就是卷盘；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 一般认为来自古英语中表示「绕线器」的词（更早来源不确定）→ 中古英语 reel（卷轴、旋转的舞）→ 舞蹈义引申出「摇晃地走」→ 现代英语又发展出「震惊发懵」与「一卷胶片」的用法。

sensesIntro.en: Reel begins as a spool that winds, passes through the amount it holds and onto machines, then borrows the turning motion for an unsteady walk, a stunned mind, and the act of winding in a line.
sensesIntro.cn: reel 先是一个负责缠绕的卷盘，再指它所容纳的量、进而指机器上的部件，然后借旋转的动作表示摇晃地走、发懵以及收线的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a spool that turns and winds a line round and round.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只不断旋转、把线一圈圈绕紧的卷盘。

branches.en: The physical spool is the source of everything else.
branches.cn: 实体的卷盘是其他一切义项的起点。

branches.en: Once a spool is full it measures film, and once mounted it becomes fishing gear.
branches.cn: 卷盘装满就成了胶片的度量单位，装到竿上又成了钓鱼器具。

branches.en: Spinning becomes walking that sways and loses balance.
branches.cn: 旋转转为摇晃着走、失去平衡的走法。

branches.en: The dizzy body gives the dizzy mind its stunned sense.
branches.cn: 眩晕的身体带来「发懵」这一心理义项。

branches.en: The noun becomes a verb that does the winding itself.
branches.cn: 名词转为动词，由它自己来完成缠绕动作。

intro.en: Reel is a short basic word with few affixes; its family grows with -ed, -ing, -er, -able, and the compound reel-to-reel.
intro.cn: reel 是个短小的基础词，词缀不多；它的词族靠 -ed、-ing、-er、-able 以及复合词 reel-to-reel 扩展。

latinIntro.en: Reel has no reliable Latin source, so no Latin relatives are listed.
latinIntro.cn: reel 没有可靠的拉丁语来源，因此不列拉丁同源词。

items.meaning: a spool; to wind or sway
items.example: Reel works as both a noun and a verb.
items.exampleCN: reel 既作名词也作动词。

items.example: The plural simply adds -s.
items.exampleCN: 复数只是加 -s。

items.example: The -ed ending marks the past.
items.exampleCN: -ed 结尾标记过去时。

items.example: The -ing form often follows the verb be.
items.exampleCN: -ing 形式常跟在动词 be 后面。

items.example: The suffix -er names the person.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 指称那个人。

items.example: The suffix -able means able to be.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -able 意为「可以……的」。

items.meaning: using two reels, one feeding the other
items.example: A compound joins reel twice to name a machine.
items.exampleCN: 复合词用两次 reel 来指一种机器。

items.example: A noun compound with fishing narrows the tool.
items.exampleCN: 与 fishing 组成名词复合词，限定用途。

items.example: Newsreel keeps the film sense in a compound.
items.exampleCN: newsreel 在复合词中保留了胶片义。

items.meaning: to pull something in by winding
items.example: The particle in shows the direction of winding.
items.exampleCN: 小品词 in 表示收线的方向。

definition_zh: （修道院、学校等处的）食堂；餐厅
definition_en: a large room in a monastery, college, or school where people eat together at long tables
core_image: 修道院里一条长桌排开，修道士在拱顶下安静地一起吃饭
scene: 修士们在钟声后走进长桌食堂。After the bell, the monks entered the refectory for supper in silence.
sceneCN: 这里 refectory 是「食堂」（第 1 个义项：修道院或学校里供集体用餐的大厅）；句意：钟声响过之后，修士们默默走进食堂吃晚饭。

pos.zh: （修道院、学院、学校等的）食堂；餐厅

derivatives.zh: 便餐；小食：与 refectory 同出拉丁语 refectio（恢复），指一顿吃喝带来的恢复
使恢复体力；给（人）供食：拉丁语 refect- 的原动词义，属较少用词
（较少见）同 refectory，亦作思虑室；与「反射」一词并无关系

senses.title: The dining hall of a monastery
senses.definition: a long communal room where monks or nuns eat together
senses.definitionCN: 修士或修女聚集用餐的长形大厅
senses.example: The monks read aloud while the others ate in the refectory.
senses.exampleCN: 修士们吃饭时，有人在一旁诵读。
senses.why: The root means to restore the body, so the refectory is literally the room where tired people are made strong again.
senses.whyCN: 词根意为「使身体恢复」，所以 refectory 字面上就是让人重新强壮起来的房间。

senses.title: The dining hall of a college or school
senses.definition: the large dining room of a college, boarding school, or similar institution
senses.definitionCN: 学院、寄宿学校或类似机构的大型用餐厅堂
senses.example: The whole college met in the refectory at seven for dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 晚上七点，全院师生都到食堂吃饭。
senses.why: College life borrowed the church word for its own large hall, so the same restoring room now serves students and fellows.
senses.whyCN: 学院生活借用了教会的这个词来指自己的大厅，于是这间「恢复体力的屋子」也接待学生与研究员。

senses.title: The long table of a dining hall
senses.definition: a very long narrow table, like the ones used in old dining halls, now often found in kitchens
senses.definitionCN: 狭长的大桌子，像旧时食堂所用，如今常见于家用厨房
senses.example: An oak refectory table stood in the middle of the kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 厨房中央摆着一张橡木长条桌。
senses.why: Furniture makers sold copies of hall tables under the hall name, so the word came to name the shape itself.
senses.whyCN: 家具商以大厅之名仿制这种长桌出售，这个词于是转指桌子的形制。

intro.en: Refectory comes through medieval Latin and French from the Latin verb reficere, meaning to remake or restore.
intro.cn: refectory 经由中世纪拉丁语与法语传到英语，源头是拉丁语动词 reficere，意为「重新做、使恢复」。

items.en: The verb reficere is built from re-, again, and facere, to make.
items.cn: 动词 reficere 由前缀 re-（再）与动词 facere（做）构成。

items.en: Refectio means a restoring, and among monks also a meal that restores strength.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 refectio 意为「恢复」，在修士中间也指恢复体力的一顿饭。

items.en: The adjective refectorius, restoring, is used of the monks dining room.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语用形容词 refectorius（用于恢复的）指修士的用餐房间。

items.en: Refectoire carries the term into French.
items.cn: 古法语 refectoire 承接了该词。

items.en: Refectory is first recorded in English for the hall of a religious house.
items.cn: 英语文献中 refectory 一词首见，用于指宗教团体的膳堂。

items.en: The word spreads to college and school dining halls, and then to the long tables found in them.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到学院与学校的食堂，后来又用来指食堂里的长桌。

note.en: Refectory is shown beside words from its own Latin root and beside everyday words for eating rooms.
note.cn: refectory 这里与同一拉丁词根的同族词并列，也和日常表示「食堂」的词并列对照。

entries.definition: a light meal or refreshment
entries.definitionCN: 便餐；点心

entries.definition: to refresh with food, a rare word
entries.definitionCN: 供食以恢复体力，属罕用词

entries.definition: a rare variant of refectory; only a spelling similarity, a different form
entries.definitionCN: refectory 的罕见异形；只是拼写相近，词形不同

entries.definition: a narrow long table of the kind used in old dining halls
entries.definitionCN: 食堂式的狭长桌

entries.definition: a large room where many people eat
entries.definitionCN: 大餐厅；食堂

entries.definition: a place where workers or soldiers eat
entries.definitionCN: （工厂、军营的）食堂

normalIntro.en: Refectory is the Latin root for restoring a body, given to the room where meals do that restoring.
normalIntro.cn: refectory 本义是「让身体恢复」，被用来称呼承担这一恢复功能的吃饭房间。

normal.en: The same -fect- appears in factory and in affect, all from Latin facere, to make.
normal.cn: factory 与 affect 里的 -fect- 与它同源，都来自拉丁语 facere（做）。

normal.en: The suffix -ory means a place for something, as in laboratory and observatory.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ory 表示「供……的场所」，如 laboratory 与 observatory。

normal.en: Refection, a meal that restores your strength, is the short cousin of refectory.
normal.cn: refection 指让人恢复力气的一餐，是 refectory 的短亲。

normal.en: In a college, the refectory is the big hall where the whole house eats together.
normal.cn: 在学院里，refectory 就是全屋人一起吃饭的大厅。

normal.en: A refectory table is the long narrow table copied from these halls.
normal.cn: refectory table 就是从这些大厅里仿制出来的狭长桌。

abstract.en: Picture a vaulted stone hall with one very long table and a bell above the door.
abstract.cn: 想象一座石拱大厅，中央一张极长的桌子，门上方挂着一口钟。

abstract.en: Think of tired monks sitting down and getting strength back from a simple meal.
abstract.cn: 想一想疲惫的修士坐下，用一顿简单的饭恢复力气。

abstract.en: Imagine a long oak table with many chairs once used in a hall and now in a modern kitchen.
abstract.cn: 想象一张配了许多椅子的橡木长桌，从前放在大厅里，如今摆在现代厨房。

examples.en: Dinner is served in the refectory at six.
examples.cn: 晚饭六点在食堂开饭。

examples.en: The abbey refectories of the region kept their painted ceilings.
examples.cn: 这一带的修道院食堂保留着彩绘天花板。

examples.en: They found a second-hand refectory table for the kitchen.
examples.cn: 他们为厨房淘到一张二手长条桌。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「蕊费可特瑞」——想着「费用特别的瑞」这样的音，走进一座长桌食堂就能想起它；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 reficere（re- 再 + facere 做 → 使恢复）→ 晚期拉丁语 refectio（恢复；一餐）→ 中世纪拉丁语 refectorius（修士膳堂的）→ 古法语 refectoire → 英语 refectory，核心义「让人恢复体力的吃饭之地」。

sensesIntro.en: Refectory keeps one idea across three uses: a hall where people are restored by food, the college hall that borrowed it, and the long table that filled such halls.
sensesIntro.cn: refectory 在三种用法里保持着同一个想法：靠食物让人恢复的大厅、借用这一称呼的学院食堂，以及曾布满这种大厅的长桌。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long hall with one long table, where tired people are restored by a meal.
core.cn: 核心意象：一间长厅、一张长桌，疲惫的人在这里吃饭恢复。

branches.en: The monks hall is the original sense of the restoring room.
branches.cn: 修士的膳堂是「恢复之室」的本义。

branches.en: Colleges borrowed the same hall and the same name.
branches.cn: 学院借用了同样的大厅与同样的名称。

branches.en: The table that filled the hall took its name from the hall.
branches.cn: 填满大厅的长桌从大厅那里取得了名字。

branches.en: Both a monastery hall and a college hall are places of shared meals.
branches.cn: 修道院大厅与学院大厅都是共同用餐的场所。

branches.en: Modern refectory tables are often the centrepiece of an eating room.
branches.cn: 现代的食堂长桌常常是一间餐厅的中心。

intro.en: Refectory is a Latin compound of a prefix and a root, closed by the place suffix -ory.
intro.cn: refectory 是由前缀与词根组成的拉丁式复合词，再加表示场所的后缀 -ory 收尾。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb reficere, to remake, gives refect- as its participle stem, meaning restored.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语动词 reficere（重做、恢复）的分词词干是 refect-，意为「已恢复的」。

items.example: The prefix re- marks a return to a former state.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 表示回到从前状态。

items.example: The root -fect- comes from facere, to make.
items.exampleCN: 词根 -fect- 来自 facere，意为「做」。

items.example: The suffix -ory names a room or a building.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ory 指称房间或建筑。

items.example: Refect is the plain verb behind the noun.
items.exampleCN: refect 是名词背后的普通动词。

items.example: Refection uses the noun suffix -ion.

definition_zh: 裁判；仲裁人；审稿人；担任裁判
definition_en: an official who watches a game closely and makes sure the players obey the rules; also a person chosen to settle a dispute or judge an academic paper
core_image: 哨子挂在胸前，比赛开始前裁判先站稳，用手指向规则
scene: 足球场边的看台上人声鼎沸，双方为一个进球是否有效争得面红耳赤。The referee blew the whistle and pointed to the penalty spot, and the players stopped arguing at once.
sceneCN: 这里 referee 是「裁判」（第 1 个义项：球场上执行规则的官员）；句意：裁判吹响哨子并指向点球点，球员们立刻停止了争辩。

pos.zh: 担任……的裁判；对……作出裁决

derivatives.zh: 裁判（工作）；动词加 -ing 构成动名词，指吹哨执法这件事
转介；推荐（同源词，来自 refer），指把事交给他人判断

senses.title: The official who enforces the rules
senses.definition: the official in charge of a game or match, whose job is to make sure the rules are obeyed
senses.definitionCN: 负责一场比赛、确保双方遵守规则的官员
senses.example: The referee sent two players off for fighting.
senses.exampleCN: 裁判因打架罚下了两名球员。
senses.why: To referee is to refer a matter to a neutral person, so the referee is the one to whom every disputed decision is referred.
senses.whyCN: 裁判来自「把事情提交给中立者判断」这一动作，所以裁判员就是每处争议最终都交给他裁断的那个人。

senses.title: The neutral judge of a dispute
senses.definition: a person chosen by both sides to examine a disagreement and give a decision
senses.definitionCN: 由双方共同选定、审查分歧并作出裁决的人
senses.example: The two companies agreed to let an outside referee settle the contract dispute.
senses.exampleCN: 两家公司同意让一位外部仲裁人来裁决合同纠纷。
senses.why: Outside sport, the same function of a neutral decision maker applies to labour, legal and political disputes.
senses.whyCN: 离开球场，中立裁断者的角色同样适用于劳资、法律与政治纠纷，这正是第二层含义的生长点。

senses.title: The reader who judges an academic paper
senses.definition: an expert who is asked to read an article, grant application or book proposal and judge its quality before it is accepted
senses.definitionCN: 受邀请在论文、基金的申请或书稿被接受前阅读并评判其质量的专家
senses.example: The referee for the paper asked for more data before publication.
senses.exampleCN: 一位审稿人要求补充更多数据后才能发表这篇论文。
senses.why: Academic publishing borrows the word for the anonymous expert to whom a manuscript is referred for judgement.
senses.whyCN: 学术出版借用了这个称呼，把稿件「提交」给不具名的专家评判，于是出现了审稿人义项。

senses.title: To act as the match official
senses.definition: to control a game or match in the role of referee
senses.definitionCN: 以裁判身份控制一场比赛
senses.example: A local teacher refereed the final match.
senses.exampleCN: 一位本地教师担任了决赛的裁判。
senses.why: Because the noun names the role, it naturally became a verb meaning to play that role.
senses.whyCN: 名词先固定了「裁判」这个身份，随后自然转用为动词，表示担任这一身份。

senses.title: To judge a piece of writing
senses.definition: to read a paper or proposal as an expert and give an opinion on whether it should be accepted
senses.definitionCN: 以专家身份阅读论文或提案，就它能否被接受给出意见
senses.example: She has refereed for several international journals this year.
senses.exampleCN: 她为多家国际期刊审阅过论文。
senses.why: The verb sense extends from the sports field to any expert judgement on a submitted piece of work.
senses.whyCN: 动词含义从赛场延伸到对提交作品的一切专家评断，审稿只是它在学术场景里的一次映射。

intro.en: Referee is an English formation from refer, itself from Latin referre, to carry back or report.
intro.cn: referee 是英语自己在 refer 后面加词尾构成的新词，而 refer 来自拉丁语 referre（带回、报告）。

items.en: Referre joins re- (back) and ferre (to carry), meaning to carry back or report.
items.cn: referre 由 re-（回）与 ferre（携带）合成，意为带回、报告。

items.en: The verb refer enters English with the sense of sending a matter to someone for decision.
items.cn: 动词 refer 在十四世纪进入英语，义为把事情送交某人决定。

items.en: The person noun referee is formed on refer with the agent ending -ee, as in employee.
items.cn: 在 refer 后加指人词尾 -ee（如 employee）构成 referee。

items.en: Sporting use fixes referee as the name of the match official.
items.cn: 体育用法把它固定为比赛执法官员的名称。

items.en: Academic publishing adopts referee for the expert who judges a submitted paper.
items.cn: 二十世纪学术出版借用该词，指评判投稿的专家。

note.en: Referee is built on refer, so its closest look-alikes are refer, reference and referral, while its near meanings are umpire, arbitrator and judge.
note.cn: referee 由 refer 派生，形近词是 refer、reference 与 referral，近义词则是 umpire、arbitrator 与 judge。

entries.definition: to send a matter to someone for decision or help
entries.definitionCN: 把某事提交给某人处理或判断

entries.definition: a mention of something, or a person who can give a character report
entries.definitionCN: 提及；推荐人；参考

entries.definition: the act of sending someone to another person or body

entries.definition: the official who judges a game such as tennis or cricket

entries.definition: a person chosen to settle a dispute outside court
entries.definitionCN: 庭外仲裁人

entries.definition: a person who decides cases in a court or a contest
entries.definitionCN: 法官；评审

normalIntro.en: Referee is the person to whom the game is referred, a point made clear by the refer inside it.
normalIntro.cn: referee 就是「比赛被提交给他」的那个人，词里的 refer 已经把这一点说得很清楚。

normal.en: See refer inside referee: the game is referred to the referee.
normal.cn: 看清 referee 里的 refer：比赛被「提交」给 referee。

normal.en: A referee blows the whistle, so hear the whistle when you read the word.
normal.cn: 裁判吹哨，读这个词时就把哨声一起记上。

normal.en: Referee, umpire and arbitrator can form a group for rules, ball games and contracts.
normal.cn: 把 referee、umpire、arbitrator 串成一组，分别对应规则、球赛与合同。

normal.en: The verb refereed papers appears on academic forms, so remember the refereed form.
normal.cn: 学术表格上常见 refereed papers 的写法，顺便记住 refereed 这个形式。

normal.en: The -ee ending marks the person who receives an action, as in referee and employee.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ee 标记「接受动作的人」，referee 与 employee 都是这样。

abstract.en: Picture a black jersey and a raised finger in the middle of a shouting crowd.
abstract.cn: 想象人声鼎沸的看台中央，一件黑色球衣和一根高举的手指。

abstract.en: Two shouting disputants are silenced by one calm stranger in the middle.
abstract.cn: 两名大声争吵的人被中间一位冷静的陌生人一句话止住。

abstract.en: See three anonymous readers leaning over a single paper in a quiet room.
abstract.cn: 想象安静的房间里，三位匿名读者俯身看同一篇论文。

examples.en: The referee stopped play because the goal was offside.
examples.cn: 裁判因越位判进球无效，终止了比赛。

examples.en: Both sides want a neutral referee to look at the contract.
examples.cn: 双方都希望由中立的仲裁人审查这份合同。

examples.en: Two reviewers refereed the study before it appeared.
examples.cn: 这篇研究发表前由两名审稿人评审过。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「瑞福瑞」：裁判手里拿着哨，为比赛守住福气，让双方不争执；这只是记音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 referre（re- 回 + ferre 携带）→ 英语 refer（提交；提及）＋指人词尾 -ee → referee，核心义「被提交询问、作出裁断的那个人」。

sensesIntro.en: Referee starts as the official who enforces the rules of a game, widens to any neutral judge of a dispute, narrows again to the expert who reads a paper, and finally turns into the verbs of officiating and reviewing.
sensesIntro.cn: referee 从球场上执行规则的裁判开始，扩展到任何纠纷的中立裁断者，再收窄为学术审稿人，最后转作动词，表示当裁判与审稿。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a whistle held in front of a steady hand.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只稳稳的手握着哨子。

branches.en: The whistle-carrying official is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 手拿哨子的执法官员是最日常的义项。

branches.en: The neutral third party in a dispute keeps the judging image outside sport.
branches.cn: 纠纷中的中立第三方，把「裁断」的画面带到赛场之外。

branches.en: The anonymous reader of a paper is the narrow, scholarly sense.
branches.cn: 匿名读稿的专家是这个词最窄的学术义项。

branches.en: Playing the role turned the noun into a verb of officiating.
branches.cn: 扮演这个角色，让名词转为表示执法的动词。

branches.en: The reviewer sense and the review verb mirror each other across academic fields.
branches.cn: 审稿人义项与评审动词义项在学术场景里互为镜像。

definition_zh: 折射；折射作用；屈光
definition_en: the change in direction of a beam of light, sound or other wave when it passes from one medium into another at an angle
core_image: 一根筷子斜插在水杯中，水面处像是被看不见的手折了一下
scene: 一杯清水里斜插着一根筷子，从侧面看过去，筷子在水面下仿佛断开了两截。The bending of the stick is caused by refraction at the meeting point of air and water.
sceneCN: 这里 refraction 是「折射」（第 1 个义项：光从一种介质进入另一种介质时改变方向）；句意：筷子弯折的样子，是空气与水交界处发生折射造成的。

derivatives.zh: 屈折（光线）；基础动词，来自拉丁语 refractus，义为使折断
折射的；屈光的，由 refract 加形容词词尾 -ive 构成
折射望远镜；折射透镜，由 refract 加器物词尾 -or 构成

senses.title: The bending of light at a boundary
senses.definition: the bending of a ray of light when it enters a different medium, such as from air into water
senses.definitionCN: 光线进入不同介质（如从空气进入水）时发生的方向改变
senses.example: Refraction makes a swimming pool look shallower than it is.
senses.exampleCN: 折射让游泳池看上去比实际更浅。
senses.why: Latin frangere means to break, so refraction is light being broken off its straight path as it crosses a boundary.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 frangere 意为「折断」，所以折射就是光在跨越介质边界时被「折断」，偏离原本的直线路径。

senses.title: The measured bending of any wave
senses.titleCN: 波（声波、无线电波）的折射
senses.definition: the same bending process applied to sound waves, radio waves or other radiation passing between media
senses.definitionCN: 声波、无线电波或其他辐射在介质之间传播时发生的同一种方向偏折
senses.example: The refraction of sound in cold air can carry voices farther than expected.
senses.exampleCN: 冷空气中声波的折射能把人声传得比预想更远。
senses.why: Once the idea is stated as a general law of waves, it applies to sound and radio as well as light.
senses.whyCN: 当折射被概括成一般的波传播规律后，它就自然从光扩展到声音与无线电波。

senses.title: The focusing of light in the eye
senses.definition: the process by which the eye bends light to focus it on the retina, and a measure of any error in this process
senses.definitionCN: 眼睛使光线弯折并聚焦到视网膜上的过程，也指这一过程中的偏差
senses.example: An eye test checks the refraction of each eye separately.
senses.exampleCN: 视力检查会分别检验两只眼睛的屈光情况。
senses.why: The eye contains a living lens, so medicine borrowed the optical word to name how that lens focuses light.
senses.whyCN: 眼睛里有活的晶状体，医学便借用了光学术语，专门指这个晶状体如何聚焦光线。

senses.title: The amount of a prism turn
senses.definition: the angle or amount by which a prism, lens or other optical part turns a beam of light
senses.definitionCN: 棱镜、透镜或其他光学部件使一束光偏转的角度或程度
senses.example: A prism of small refraction splits white light into the colours of a rainbow.
senses.exampleCN: 偏折度很小的棱镜也能把白光拆成彩虹般的颜色。
senses.why: Laboratory use turns the event into a quantity that can be set and measured on optical equipment.
senses.whyCN: 实验室用法把一次偏折变成可以在光学器材上设定与测量的量，于是产生这一层含义。

senses.title: The atmospheric bending of starlight
senses.definition: the bending of light by layers of air, which makes stars and the sun appear slightly higher than they are
senses.definitionCN: 光被层层空气弯折，使星星和太阳看上去比实际位置略高
senses.example: Atmospheric refraction lets us see the sun for a few minutes after it has set.
senses.exampleCN: 大气折射让我们在太阳落山后还能多看见它几分钟。
senses.why: Air of changing density behaves like many thin lenses, so the same bending shows up in the sky.
senses.whyCN: 密度不断变化的空气就像许多薄透镜叠在一起，同样的偏折于是出现在天空中。

intro.en: Refraction comes from Latin refractio, a breaking, from refractus, the past participle of refringere, to break open or break back.
intro.cn: refraction 来自拉丁语 refractio（折断），源于 refringere（打破、折返）的过去分词 refractus。

items.en: Frangere means to break, and the prefix re- adds back or again.
items.cn: frangere 意为打破，前缀 re- 加上「回」或「再」。

items.en: Refringere gives the participle refractus, while the related noun refractio belongs to Late Latin scientific writing.
items.cn: refringere 给出过去分词 refractus，而相关名词 refractio 则是晚期拉丁语科学著作中的用法。

items.en: Optical writers apply refraction to light bent as it passes from one clear medium into another.
items.cn: 中世纪的复视学者把这个词用于光从一种透明介质进入另一种时发生的偏折。

items.en: By the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries refraction is well established in English optics.
items.cn: 到十六、十七世纪，refraction 已在英语光学文献中站稳脚跟。

items.en: Companion forms such as refract, refractive and refraction index spread through science.
items.cn: refract、refractive 与折射率等配套说法在科学界广泛流传。

note.en: Refraction shares its frang- root with fracture and fragment, and sits beside reflection, diffraction and dispersion in the optics vocabulary.
note.cn: refraction 与 fracture、fragment 共享折断词根，在光学词汇中和 reflection、diffraction、dispersion 相邻。

normalIntro.en: Refraction carries the Latin root for breaking, so think of a straight beam being bent like a stick snapped at the water line.
normalIntro.cn: refraction 含有拉丁语「折断」词根，所以可以想象一束光在水面处像木棍被折了一下。

normal.en: Spot the fract inside refraction, the same root as fracture and fragment.
normal.cn: 看出 refraction 里的 fract，它和 fracture、fragment 同根。

normal.en: Refraction happens when light moves from air into water or glass.
normal.cn: 光从空气进入水或玻璃时会发生折射。

normal.en: The angle of refraction is measured between the bent ray and the normal line.
normal.cn: 折射角是在偏折后的光线与法线之间测量的。

normal.en: The index of refraction tells how strongly a medium bends light.
normal.cn: 折射率说明一种介质使光偏折的强弱。

normal.en: Keep refraction apart from reflection: one bends, the other bounces back.
normal.cn: 把 refraction 与 reflection 分开记：一个弯折，一个反弹。

abstract.en: See a chopstick snapped in two at the water surface of a clear glass.
abstract.cn: 想象一只清透的玻璃杯里，筷子在水面处被截成两段。

abstract.en: Picture ripples slowing down where they meet shallow sand.
abstract.cn: 想象水波触到浅滩时骤然放慢。

abstract.en: Watch the sun flatten and rise again above the sea at dusk.
abstract.cn: 想象黄昏时太阳在海面上被压扁又重新升起。

examples.en: Refraction explains why a straw looks broken in a glass of water.
examples.cn: 折射解释了吸管在玻璃水杯中看上去为什么像断了一样。

examples.en: The index of refraction of water is about one and a third.
examples.cn: 水的折射率约为一点三三。

examples.en: Atmospheric refraction makes the sun visible after it has dipped below the horizon.
examples.cn: 大气折射让太阳沉入地平线之后仍能被看见。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「瑞弗来克神」：光在水面被折了一下又一下；这只是记音拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 frangere（折断）→ refractus（被折断的）→ 中世纪拉丁语 refractio（折断）→ 英语 refraction，核心义「光线在介质交界处被折断」。

sensesIntro.en: Refraction begins as light bending as it crosses from one medium into another, extends to sound and radio waves, and then takes on special uses in the eye, in optical instruments and in the atmosphere.
sensesIntro.cn: refraction 最初指光跨越介质时发生的弯折，后来扩展到声波与无线电波，再在眼科、光学仪器与大气现象中长出专门用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a straight beam snapping at the water line.
core.cn: 核心意象：一束笔直的光在水面处折断。

branches.en: Light bending at a boundary is the core sense.
branches.cn: 光在介质边界弯折是核心义项。

branches.en: Any wave obeying the same law carries the sense into acoustics and radio.
branches.cn: 任何遵循同一规律的波，都把这一含义带进声学与无线电领域。

branches.en: The eye lens applies the same bending inside the body.
branches.cn: 眼睛的晶状体在人体内应用同样的弯折。

branches.en: Optical devices turn the bending into a setting or a measurement.
branches.cn: 光学器件把这种弯折变成可设定、可测量的量。

branches.en: Air of changing density bends star light and explains a bending sky.
branches.cn: 密度变化的空气弯折星光，解释天空中的这类弯折。

intro.en: Refraction is a noun of Latin making, with the verb refract and the adjectives refractive and refractable built around it.
intro.cn: refraction 是拉丁语式的名词，围绕它构成动词 refract 与形容词 refractive、refractable。

latinIntro.en: Latin refringere, from re- (back) and frangere (to break), gives the line its image of a ray broken off its path.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 refringere 由 re-（回）与 frangere（折断）组成，给这个词带来光线被折断偏离路径的意象。

items.example: Water refracts light as it enters.
items.exampleCN: 光进入水时会发生折射。

items.example: The suffix -ion forms refraction.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ion 构成 refraction。

items.example: Refraction names the bending itself.
items.exampleCN: refraction 指弯折这件事本身。

items.example: Several refractions add up in a thick lens.
items.exampleCN: 在厚透镜中，多次折射会叠加起来。

items.example: The suffix -ive forms refractive.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ive 构成 refractive。

items.example: Refractive means capable of bending light.
items.exampleCN: refractive 表示具有使光折射的能力。

items.meaningCN: 表示器物或行为者的词尾
items.example: The suffix -or forms refractor.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -or 构成 refractor。

items.meaning: a telescope that works by bending light
items.example: A refractor uses a lens, not a mirror.
items.exampleCN: 折射望远镜用透镜而不用反射镜。

items.example: The suffix -able forms refractable.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -able 构成 refractable。

items.example: Refractable light can be turned by a prism.
items.exampleCN: 可折射的光能被棱镜偏转。

latinEntries.meaning: to break open, to bend back

definition_zh: 克制；忍住；避免；副歌；叠句
definition_en: to stop yourself from doing something; as a noun, the repeated line at the end of each verse of a song or poem
core_image: 正要伸出手的人停在半空，把那句话咽回喉咙
scene: 会议眼看要变成争吵，主持人按住桌面，示意大家先别急着插话。She managed to refrain from interrupting and let the youngest speaker finish.
sceneCN: 这里 refrain 是「克制不做」（第 1 个义项：忍住不去做某事）；句意：她忍住了没有插话，让最年轻的发言人把话说完。

derivatives.zh: 克制；忍耐，由动词 refrain 加名词词尾 -ment 构成
（极少用）克制者，由动词 refrain 加指人词尾 -er 构成

senses.title: To hold yourself back from acting
senses.definition: to deliberately stop yourself from doing something you are tempted to do
senses.definitionCN: 刻意制止自己去做很想做的事
senses.example: He refrained from laughing until the meeting was over.
senses.exampleCN: 他忍到会议结束才笑出来。
senses.why: The verb builds on Latin refrenare, to put a bridle on, so refraining is pulling back on your own reins.
senses.whyCN: 动词来自拉丁语 refrenare，意为给马套上辔头，所以克制就是自己拉紧自己的缰绳。

senses.title: The repeated line in a song
senses.definition: a line or group of lines repeated at the end of each verse of a song or poem
senses.definitionCN: 在每段歌或诗的末尾重复出现的一行或几行
senses.example: The last line of every verse is a refrain about the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 每段诗的最后一行都是关于大海的叠句。
senses.why: The noun comes from Old French refraindre, to break off and repeat, so a refrain is the line that breaks and comes back again.
senses.whyCN: 名词来自古法语 refraindre（折断并重复），所以副歌就是反复「折回来」的那一句。

senses.title: A complaint that keeps coming back
senses.titleCN: 老生常谈的抱怨；反复出现的说法
senses.definition: a remark or complaint that someone keeps repeating, often to the point of weariness
senses.definitionCN: 某人反复重复、往往让人听得厌烦的话或抱怨
senses.example: Rising rents became his constant refrain whenever the family met.
senses.exampleCN: 每次家人聚会，房租上涨都成了他不变的老调。
senses.why: Once the noun meant any repeated phrase, it naturally spread to repeated complaints in ordinary speech.
senses.whyCN: 名词一旦表示「任何重复的语句」，就自然延伸为日常话语中反复出现的抱怨，这就是老调含义的来源。

intro.en: Refrain has two strands: a verb from Latin refrenare, to rein in, and a noun from Old French refraindre, to break off.
intro.cn: refrain 有两条源流：动词来自拉丁语 refrenare（勒住），名词来自古法语 refraindre（折断、中止）。

items.en: Frenum means a bridle, and refrenare means to put a bridle on and so to check or restrain.
items.cn: frenum 意为辔头，refrenare 意为套上辔头，转指制止、约束。

items.en: Refraindre, to break off, supplies the noun sense of a phrase that breaks off and repeats.
items.cn: 古法语 refraindre（折断）为名词提供「中段折回、重复」的含义。

items.en: The verb enters English in the sense of restraining oneself.
items.cn: 动词以克制自身这一含义进入英语。

items.en: The noun is used for the repeated part of a song or poem.
items.cn: 名词开始用于表示歌或诗里重复的部分。

items.en: Both the verb and the noun are common, and the verb works mainly with from.
items.cn: 动词与名词都属常用，动词主要与介词 from 搭配。

note.en: Refrain is close in form to refrainment and restrain, and in meaning to abstain, desist and chorus.
note.cn: refrain 词形上与 refrainment、restrain 相近，意义上与 abstain、desist、chorus 相邻。

entries.definition: the act of holding oneself back
entries.definitionCN: 克制；忍耐

entries.definition: to keep under control
entries.definitionCN: 抑制；勒住（与 refrain 意义相近，但拼写不同，来自拉丁语 stringere「拉紧」）

entries.definition: to bend light or sound
entries.definitionCN: 使折射；只是拼写相近，词根为 frangere 折断，与 refrain 词源不同

entries.definition: to choose not to do or take something
entries.definitionCN: 戒除；弃权

entries.definition: to stop doing something
entries.definitionCN: 停止；终止

entries.definition: the part of a song repeated after each verse
entries.definitionCN: 合唱段；副歌

normalIntro.en: Refrain is pulling on your own reins, and the noun sense is the line that keeps coming back.
normalIntro.cn: refrain 是拉紧自己的缰绳，而名词义则是那句不断折回来的话。

normal.en: The verb refrain almost always takes from before the action.
normal.cn: 动词 refrain 后面几乎总要用介词 from 再接动作。

normal.en: See the Latin frenum, a bridle, inside the verb story of refrain.
normal.cn: 动词的来源包含拉丁语 frenum（辔头），和勒住缰绳的画面连在一起。

normal.en: Refrain from smoking appears on many public signs.
normal.cn: refrain from smoking 常出现在公共告示上。

normal.en: Keep the verb refrain apart from restrain, which needs an object.
normal.cn: 把动词 refrain 与 restrain 分开：后者要带宾语。

normal.en: A catchy refrain is the part of a song that everybody joins in.
normal.cn: catchy refrain 就是一首歌里人人跟着唱的部分。

abstract.en: See a hand lifted to speak and then lowered again, word after word.
abstract.cn: 想象一只举起要发言的手，又一次次放下来。

abstract.en: Hear one line of a song return after every verse, like a wave.
abstract.cn: 每段之后再回来一句同样的歌词，像一波海浪。

abstract.en: Hear the same complaint surface at every family dinner.
abstract.cn: 想象每次家庭聚餐都冒出同一句抱怨。

examples.en: Please refrain from feeding the animals on the track.
examples.cn: 请勿在赛道上给动物喂食。

examples.en: She refrained from raising her voice even when the debate turned ugly.
examples.cn: 即使辩论变得难听，她也克制住没有提高嗓门。

examples.en: The refrain of the song is repeated four times before the end.
examples.cn: 这首歌的副歌在结束前重复了四次。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「瑞弗忍」：瑞弗这个人很能忍，什么话都咽回去；这只是记音联想，与词源无关。

root: 两条源流：其一为拉丁语 frenum（辔头）→ refrenare（勒住）→ 英语动词 refrain（克制）；其二为古法语 refraindre（折断、中止）→ 英语名词 refrain（副歌、叠句）。

sensesIntro.en: Refrain is first a verb meaning to rein yourself in, then a noun for the repeating line of a song, and finally any phrase or complaint that keeps coming back.
sensesIntro.cn: refrain 先是表示「勒住自己」的动词，再是歌中反复出现的句子，最后泛指任何不断冒出来的说法或抱怨。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand stopped mid-reach.
core.cn: 核心意象：伸到一半的手停在半空。

branches.en: Pulling on the reins is the verb sense of holding back.
branches.cn: 拉紧缰绳，构成「克制」的动词义项。

branches.en: A line that breaks off and returns is the song sense.
branches.cn: 一句话「折断」后又回来，是副歌义项。

branches.en: Any repeated phrase widens the noun into everyday speech.
branches.cn: 任何重复的语句都让名词义扩展到日常口语。

branches.en: Holding back speech and holding back a complaint share the same inner pause.
branches.cn: 忍住不说与忍住抱怨，共享同一个内心的停顿。

branches.en: A refrain and a repeated complaint both return again and again.
branches.cn: 副歌与反复出现的抱怨一样，都是一次次地回来。

intro.en: Refrain carries the Latin idea of a rein, and the noun line of the word grew from Old French into song and speech.
intro.cn: refrain 承载拉丁语「缰绳」的意义，名词源流则从古法语长入音乐与日常话语。

latinIntro.en: Latin frenum means a bridle, and refrenare means to check by the reins, which gives the verb its sense of restraint.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 frenum 意为辔头，refrenare 意为用缰绳约束，这给了动词「克制」的含义。

items.example: Refrain takes from before a gerund.
items.exampleCN: refrain 常接 from 加动名词。

items.example: He refrains from comment.
items.exampleCN: 他不予评论。

items.example: The suffix -ed forms refrained.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ed 构成 refrained。

items.example: They refrained from shouting.
items.exampleCN: 他们忍住了没有喊。

items.example: The suffix -ing forms refraining.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ing 构成 refraining。

items.meaning: in the act of holding back
items.example: Refraining from reply was her answer.
items.exampleCN: 不作回答就是她的回答。

items.example: The suffix -ment forms refrainment.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ment 构成 refrainment。

items.example: Refrainment is rare in an angry crowd.
items.exampleCN: 愤怒的人群中很少见到克制。

items.example: Frenum is the image behind restraint.
items.exampleCN: frenum 是「约束」背后的画面。

items.example: Refrenare is the ancestor of the verb.
items.exampleCN: refrenare 是动词义项的祖先。

definition_zh: 复习课程；进修课；使人恢复精神的东西；清凉饮料
definition_en: something that renews knowledge or energy, especially a short course that brings old skills back up to date
core_image: 一杯凉水泼在脸上，昏沉的人立刻清醒过来
scene: 新学年开始前，学生参加了两天的数学补习课，把忘掉的公式重新捡起来。Before the new term, the students took a two-day refresher course to revive the formulas they had forgotten.
sceneCN: 这里 refresher 是「复习课程、进修课」（第 1 个义项：把旧知识重新激活的短课）；句意：新学年开始前，学生参加了两天的数学补习课，把忘掉的公式重新捡起来。

derivatives.zh: 基础动词，义为「使恢复精神；更新」
refresh 加 -ing 构成，义为「使人清凉的；令人耳目一新的」
refresh 加 -ment 构成，义为「恢复精神；茶点」

senses.title: A short course that revives old skills
senses.definition: a short course or training session that helps people remember or update knowledge they already partly have
senses.definitionCN: 帮助人们重新记住或更新已有知识的短期课程或培训
senses.example: Nurses must take a refresher every two years.
senses.exampleCN: 护士每两年必须上一次进修课。
senses.why: The -er ending turns refresh into a thing that refreshes, and in working life that thing is most often a short course.
senses.whyCN: -er 词尾把 refresh（使恢复）变成「起恢复作用的东西」，在职场里这个东西最常见的就是短期课程，所以「复习课」成了最常用的义项。

senses.title: Anything that revives a person
senses.definition: a drink, food, or brief rest that quickly restores energy
senses.definitionCN: 能迅速恢复精力的饮料、食物或短暂休息
senses.example: A cold shower is a good refresher after a long drive.
senses.exampleCN: 长途驾驶之后，冲个冷水澡最能提神。
senses.why: The same -er pattern names a concrete thing that refreshes the body, not only knowledge.
senses.whyCN: 同一个 -er 构词模式也可以指提神的具体事物：它恢复的不是知识，而是身体，于是这个义项自然地长了出来。

senses.title: A quick reminder
senses.definition: a brief reminder or summary that brings an idea back to the mind
senses.definitionCN: 把某个想法重新带回脑海的简短提示或小结
senses.example: Give me a refresher on what the rule says.
senses.exampleCN: 给我简单提一下这条规则说的是什么。
senses.why: If a course refreshes a whole skill, a single reminder refreshes one small point, so the word can shrink to mean any brief recall.
senses.whyCN: 既然一门课能刷新一整套技能，那么一句提示就能刷新一个小知识点，于是这个词又可以缩小为「简要回顾」。

intro.en: Refresher is a native English formation: refresh, from Old French refrescher, plus the agent suffix -er.
intro.cn: refresher 是英语本土构成的词：refresh（来自古法语 refrescher）加上表示「起……作用者」的后缀 -er。

items.en: Both halves of refresh go back to Germanic roots, with re- meaning again and fresh meaning new or cool.
items.cn: refresh 的两半都可以追溯到日耳曼语词根：re- 表「再次」，fresh 表「新的；清凉的」。

items.en: Old French refrescher combines the prefix re- with frais, meaning fresh or cool.
items.cn: 古法语 refrescher 把前缀 re- 与 frais（新鲜的、凉爽的）组合在一起。

items.en: Refresh enters Middle English in the sense of renewing strength or spirit.
items.cn: refresh 在十四世纪进入中古英语，意为恢复体力或精神。

items.en: Refresher first names a drink or a thing that restores the body.
items.cn: refresher 最初指饮料或能恢复身体的事物。

items.en: In present-day English a refresher course or a refresher for a doctor is the dominant sense.
items.cn: 在现代英语里，「进修课」以及医生的「复训」已成为主导义项。

note.en: Refresher belongs to the refresh family and sits near words for training and for brief revision.
note.cn: refresher 属于 refresh 词族，并与培训类、简短复习类的词相邻。

entries.definition: to give new energy to, or to update
entries.definitionCN: 使恢复精神；更新

entries.definition: cool and pleasant, or pleasantly new
entries.definitionCN: 清凉宜人的；令人耳目一新的

entries.definition: the act of restoring energy, or light food and drink
entries.definitionCN: 恢复精神；茶点

entries.definition: training that teaches a new or updated skill
entries.definitionCN: 再培训；转岗培训

entries.definition: the act of studying work again before an exam
entries.definitionCN: 复习；温习

entries.definition: something that gives a lift to energy or confidence
entries.definitionCN: 促进；鼓舞之物

normalIntro.en: Refresher is refresh plus -er: the thing that does the refreshing, whether a course, a drink, or a reminder.
normalIntro.cn: refresher 就是 refresh 加 -er：承担「refresh」作用的东西，可能是一堂课、一杯饮料或一句提醒。

normal.en: A refresher course brings a tired skill back to life.
normal.cn: refresher course 让生疏的技能重新活起来。

normal.en: Doctors attend a refresher every year.
normal.cn: 医生每年都要参加一次进修课。

normal.en: A cold drink is a quick refresher on a hot day.
normal.cn: 热天里一杯冷饮就是快速的提神之物。

normal.en: Give me a refresher on the main points.
normal.cn: 给我简要回顾一下要点。

normal.en: Compare refreshment: refresher is the thing or course, refreshment is the process or the food and drink.
normal.cn: 对比 refreshment：refresher 指起作用的课程或事物，refreshment 指过程或茶点。

abstract.en: Picture a faded map being redrawn in clear ink.
abstract.cn: 想象一张褪色的地图被重新用清晰的墨线描出来。

abstract.en: Imagine a window being wiped clear after rain.
abstract.cn: 想象一场雨后窗户被擦得透亮。

abstract.en: Think of a lamp flickering once before it shines steadily.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏灯闪了一下，然后稳定地亮起来。

examples.en: All staff attend a safety refresher at the start of the year.
examples.cn: 每年年初全体员工都要参加安全进修课。

examples.en: She signed up for a refresher course in Spanish before her trip.
examples.cn: 旅行前她报了一门西班牙语复习课。

examples.en: The mountain air was a welcome refresher after a week indoors.
examples.cn: 在室内待了一周后，山间空气令人格外精神。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞夫雷舍」——瑞气重新灌注到房间里，人就精神了；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 日耳曼语词根 fresh（新的、清凉的）+ re-（再次）→ 古法语 refrescher（使其重新新鲜）→ 中古英语 refresh → refresh + 后缀 -er（起……作用者）→ refresher，核心义「重新变得清爽、有力」。

sensesIntro.en: Refresher starts as a short course that renews skills, extends to any thing that restores the body, and narrows again to a brief reminder.
sensesIntro.cn: refresher 先指更新技能的短期课程，再扩展到任何恢复身体的提神之物，最后又能缩小为一句简短回顾。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: cold water on a sleeping face, waking it at once.
core.cn: 核心意象：一捧凉水泼在昏睡的脸上，人立刻清醒。

branches.en: The course sense is the working and study sense.
branches.cn: 课程义是职场与学习场景中的核心用法。

branches.en: A drink or rest that restores the body is the physical sense.
branches.cn: 能恢复身体的饮料或休息是身体层面的义项。

branches.en: A short reminder is the smallest unit of refreshment.
branches.cn: 简短提示是「刷新」的最小单位。

branches.en: Both a course and a reminder bring back knowledge that had faded.
branches.cn: 课程与提示都是把淡忘的知识重新唤回。

branches.en: Training and rest are two ways of restoring a person.
branches.cn: 培训和休息都是恢复一个人状态的方式。

intro.en: Refresher is built from the free root fresh with the prefix re- and the suffix -er.
intro.cn: refresher 由自由词根 fresh 加前缀 re- 与后缀 -er 构成。

latinIntro.en: The word is Germanic in origin; Latin supplies no ancestor, though the prefix re- is shared with Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词源于日耳曼语，拉丁语没有直接祖先；只有前缀 re- 与拉丁语同形。

items.example: Fresh supplies the idea of newness.
items.exampleCN: fresh 提供「新」的核心概念。

items.example: The prefix re- adds the idea of doing it again.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 增添「再来一次」的意思。

items.example: Refresh is the base verb of the family.
items.exampleCN: refresh 是这个词族的基础动词。

items.meaning: a person or thing that does something
items.example: The suffix -er forms refresher from refresh.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 由 refresh 构成 refresher。

items.example: The suffix -ing forms refreshing.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ing 构成 refreshing。

items.meaning: restoration of energy, or food and drink
items.example: The suffix -ment forms refreshment.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ment 构成 refreshment。

items.meaning: result or process of an action
items.example: The suffix -ment turns verbs into nouns of result.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ment 把动词变为表示结果的名词。

items.example: Refresher combines refresh and -er.
items.exampleCN: refresher 由 refresh 与 -er 组合而成。

latinEntries.example: Latin re- matches the English prefix in form and meaning.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语 re- 与英语前缀形义相同。

definition_zh: 茶点；点心饮料；恢复精神；消遣
definition_en: light food or drink that restores energy, or the feeling of being refreshed
core_image: 走累的行人在树下歇脚，接过一杯凉柠檬水
scene: 会议中场休息时，大家在走廊里取用点心饮料，互相聊了几句。At the break, everyone took some refreshment in the corridor and talked for a while.
sceneCN: 这里 refreshment 是「茶点、点心饮料」（第 1 个义项：让人恢复体力的饮食）；句意：会议中场休息时，大家在走廊里取用点心饮料，互相聊了几句。

collocations.zh: 用些茶点；吃点东西提神

derivatives.zh: 基础动词，义为「使恢复精神；更新」
refresh 加 -er 构成，义为「进修课；提神之物」
refresh 加 -ing 构成，义为「清凉宜人的」

senses.title: Light food and drink
senses.definition: small amounts of food and drink served to keep people comfortable, especially at meetings or events
senses.definitionCN: 在会议或活动上供人取用、令人舒服的少量饮食
senses.example: Light refreshments will be served after the talk.
senses.exampleCN: 讲座结束后将供应简单茶点。
senses.why: The -ment noun names the settled result of refreshing, and in practice that result is very often a plate of cakes and cups of tea.
senses.whyCN: -ment 名词指「refresh 之后落定的结果」，而日常里这个结果最常见的样子就是一盘点心与几杯茶，因此「茶点」成了首选义项。

senses.title: The feeling of being renewed
senses.definition: the state of feeling fresh and strong again after rest or food
senses.definitionCN: 休息或进食后重新感到精神、有力量的状态
senses.example: He woke late, full of refreshment after the long journey.
senses.exampleCN: 他睡到很晚，长途旅行之后感到浑身轻松。
senses.why: Taken as a process noun, refreshment is the act of becoming fresh again, so it can name the inner feeling of renewal.
senses.whyCN: 作为过程名词，refreshment 指「重新变得新鲜」这件事本身，于是自然能指内在的焕然一新之感。

senses.title: Something that relieves the mind
senses.definition: anything that relieves tiredness of mind and gives a pleasant change
senses.definitionCN: 缓解精神疲劳、带来愉快变化的任何事物
senses.example: A walk by the river is a real refreshment after hours of typing.
senses.exampleCN: 敲了几个小时键盘后，沿河散步确实令人焕然一新。
senses.why: If food refreshes the body, music and company can refresh the mind, so the word widens from drinks to any pleasant relief.
senses.whyCN: 既然食物能让身体焕新，音乐与陪伴也能让头脑焕新，于是这个词从饮食扩展到任何令人愉快的解脱。

intro.en: Refreshment is refresh plus the Latin-derived noun suffix -ment, which marks the result or process of an action.
intro.cn: refreshment 由 refresh 与源自拉丁语的名词后缀 -ment 组成，-ment 表示行为的结果或过程。

items.en: The fresh part of the word goes back to a Germanic adjective meaning new or cool.
items.cn: 词中 fresh 那一部分可追溯到日耳曼语中意为「新的、清凉的」的形容词。

items.en: Old French refrescher gives English the verb refresh.
items.cn: 古法语 refrescher 给英语提供了动词 refresh。

items.en: The ending -ment comes from Latin -mentum, a suffix forming nouns of means or result.
items.cn: 词尾 -ment 来自拉丁语 -mentum，是构成手段或结果名词的后缀。

items.en: Refreshment first names the act of restoring strength.
items.cn: refreshment 最早指恢复力量这一行为。

items.en: By modern times the plural refreshments almost always means food and drink.
items.cn: 到现代，复数形式 refreshments 几乎总是指饮食。

note.en: Refreshment is the noun of outcome in the refresh family, close to words for snacks, breaks, and recovery.
note.cn: refreshment 是 refresh 词族中表示结果的名词，与点心、休息、恢复类词相邻。

entries.definition: to restore energy or bring up to date
entries.definitionCN: 使恢复精神；更新

entries.definition: a short course or thing that refreshes
entries.definitionCN: 进修课；提神之物

entries.definition: cool and pleasant
entries.definitionCN: 清凉宜人的

entries.definition: a small amount of food between meals
entries.definitionCN: 点心；小吃

entries.definition: a short rest from work
entries.definitionCN: 休息；间歇

entries.definition: the return to a normal state of health
entries.definitionCN: 恢复；康复

normalIntro.en: Refreshment is the noun of result: what you get after being refreshed, either a plate of food or a renewed feeling.
normalIntro.cn: refreshment 是表示结果的名词：被 refresh 之后得到的东西——或是一盘食物，或是一种焕新的感觉。

normal.en: Light refreshments were served in the hall.
normal.cn: 大厅里供应了简单茶点。

normal.en: The plural refreshments nearly always means food and drink.
normal.cn: 复数 refreshments 几乎总是指饮食。

normal.en: A refreshment break gives tired visitors a pause.
normal.cn: 茶歇让疲惫的来访者得到喘息。

normal.en: Long walks are a refreshment for the mind.
normal.cn: 长时间散步是对头脑的一种消遣。

normal.en: Compare refresher: a refresher is a course or thing, refreshment is the food or the resulting mood.
normal.cn: 对比 refresher：refresher 指课程或事物，refreshment 指食物或由此产生的状态。

abstract.en: Picture a tray of small cakes and cold drinks on a table.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上有一盘点心与几杯冷饮的托盘。

abstract.en: Imagine shoulders dropping as a tired person sits down.
abstract.cn: 想象疲惫的人一坐下，肩膀就松了下来。

abstract.en: Think of a hot drink warming frozen fingers.
abstract.cn: 想象一杯热饮把冻僵的手指暖过来。

examples.en: Refreshments will be provided after the ceremony.
examples.cn: 典礼结束后将提供茶点。

examples.en: Visitors can buy refreshments at the small stall by the gate.
examples.cn: 游客可以在门口的小摊买点心饮料。

examples.en: A short walk in the garden was all the refreshment she needed.
examples.cn: 在花园里走一走就是她所需要的全部放松。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞弗男士们」——一群男士在会间端起点心饮料，重新变得神采奕奕；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 日耳曼语 fresh（新的、清凉的）+ re-（再次）→ 古法语 refrescher → 英语 refresh + 拉丁语后缀 -ment（-mentum，表示结果或过程）→ refreshment，核心义「重新焕新的结果」。

sensesIntro.en: Refreshment moves from the concrete result, food and drink, to the inner feeling of renewal, and finally to any relief of the mind.
sensesIntro.cn: refreshment 从具体的结果（茶点）走向内在的焕新之感，最后扩展到任何让精神松弛的事物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tired walker taking a glass of cool lemonade in the shade.
core.cn: 核心意象：疲惫的行人在树荫下接过一杯凉柠檬水。

branches.en: The plate of cakes is the concrete sense.
branches.cn: 一盘点心是具体的义项。

branches.en: Feeling new again is the inner state sense.
branches.cn: 再度焕然一新是内在状态义项。

branches.en: Relief for the tired mind is the figurative sense.
branches.cn: 让疲惫头脑放松是比喻义项。

branches.en: Food and drink are what produce the renewed feeling.
branches.cn: 饮食是产生焕新感的来源。

branches.en: Both a shower and a good book leave the mind lighter.
branches.cn: 冲个澡和读本好书都能让心情轻松。

intro.en: Refreshment joins the free root fresh, the prefix re-, and the noun suffix -ment.
intro.cn: refreshment 把自由词根 fresh、前缀 re- 与名词后缀 -ment 连接在一起。

latinIntro.en: The verb is Germanic and French, but the ending -ment is Latin -mentum.
latinIntro.cn: 动词部分来自日耳曼语与法语，但词尾 -ment 是拉丁语 -mentum。

items.example: Fresh gives the word its core idea.
items.exampleCN: fresh 提供这个词的核心概念。

items.example: The prefix re- means making fresh again.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 表示「再次变得新鲜」。

items.example: Refresh is the base verb.
items.exampleCN: refresh 是基础动词。

items.meaning: result or means of an action
items.example: The suffix -ment forms refreshment.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ment 构成 refreshment。

items.meaning: food and drink, or renewed feeling
items.example: Refreshment combines all three parts.
items.exampleCN: refreshment 由这三部分组合而成。

items.example: The suffix -er forms refresher.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 构成 refresher。

items.example: The suffix -ing forms refreshing.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ing 构成 refreshing。

items.example: Refreshing describes a cool drink.
items.exampleCN: refreshing 形容凉爽的饮料。

latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语 -mentum 在英语中保留为 -ment。

latinEntries.example: Latin re- matches the English prefix.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语 re- 与英语前缀相同。

definition_zh: 避难所；庇护所；庇护；避难；藏身之处
definition_en: a place or state of safety from danger, trouble, or pursuit
core_image: 暴风雨中的小屋，门在身后关上，风雨声被挡在门外
scene: 山洪冲下山坡，村民挤进半山腰的一座小教堂躲避。When the flood swept down the valley, the villagers took refuge in a small church on the hillside.
sceneCN: 这里 refuge 是「避难所」（第 1 个义项：躲避危险的场所，此处用短语形式表示躲进某处）；句意：山洪冲下山坡，村民挤进半山腰的一座小教堂躲避。

derivatives.zh: refuge 加 -ee（受动者）构成，义为「难民」
拉丁语借词，义为「生物在冰期幸存下来的避难区域」
refugee 加 -ism 构成，义为「难民境况；难民身份」

senses.title: A place of safety
senses.definition: a building or place where someone can be safe from danger or bad weather
senses.definitionCN: 可以躲避危险或恶劣天气的建筑物或地点
senses.example: The old barn became a refuge during the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨中那座旧谷仓成了避风的地方。
senses.why: The Latin verb refugere means to flee back, and the place you flee back to is the basic sense of a refuge.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语动词 refugere 意为「逃回」，而逃回去的那个地方正是 refuge 最基本的义项——避难所。

senses.title: The act of being sheltered
senses.definition: protection or shelter given to someone who is in danger
senses.definitionCN: 给予身处危险者的保护或收容
senses.example: The family found refuge in a neighbouring country.
senses.exampleCN: 这家人到邻国寻求庇护。
senses.why: The noun can name the sheltering itself rather than the building, so phrases like take refuge describe the action of being protected.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词可以指「受庇护」这件事而不是建筑物，所以「take refuge」这样的搭配描述的是被收容这一动作。

senses.title: A way of escaping trouble
senses.definition: a thing or habit people turn to in order to escape worry, noise, or an unpleasant situation
senses.definitionCN: 人们为逃避忧虑、喧嚣或不利处境而求助于的事物或习惯
senses.example: Music was his refuge from the noise of the city.
senses.exampleCN: 音乐是他逃离城市喧嚣的避难所。
senses.why: Once safety stops meaning physical danger, any place or habit that hides you from stress can stretch the word into a figurative refuge.
senses.whyCN: 一旦「安全」不再指物理危险，任何能把你从压力中藏起来的场所或习惯都可以延伸为比喻性的避难所。

intro.en: Refuge comes from Latin refugium, a place to flee back to, from the verb refugere, to flee back.
intro.cn: refuge 来自拉丁语 refugium（逃回去的地方），源自动词 refugere（逃回）。

items.en: Latin re- means back and fugere means to flee, giving refugere, to flee back.
items.cn: 拉丁语 re- 意为「回」，fugere 意为「逃跑」，组合成 refugere（逃回）。

items.en: The noun refugium names the place one flees back to for safety.
items.cn: 名词 refugium 指为了安全而逃回去的地方。

items.en: Old French refuge carries the word onward, and the spelling loses the Latin ending -ium.
items.cn: 古法语 refuge 把这个词继续传下去，拼写少了拉丁词尾 -ium。

items.en: Refuge enters English as a name for a place of shelter.
items.cn: refuge 在十四世纪进入英语，指避难之所。

items.en: Refugee is formed from refuge for those who fled France, and later spreads to displaced people everywhere.
items.cn: refugee 由 refuge 派生，最初指逃离法国的人，后来泛指各地流离失所者。

items.en: Modern English adds wildlife refuges and figurative refuges from stress.
items.cn: 现代英语又增添了野生动物保护区以及比喻意义上的「精神避难所」。

note.en: Refuge shares the Latin root fugere with fugitive, and sits near shelter, sanctuary, and asylum words.
note.cn: refuge 与 fugitive 共享拉丁词根 fugere，并与 shelter、sanctuary、asylum 等词相邻。

entries.definition: a person who has fled their country for safety
entries.definitionCN: 难民；逃亡者

entries.definition: a person who is running away from the law
entries.definitionCN: 逃犯；逃亡者

entries.definition: an area where species survive a period of bad climate
entries.definitionCN: 生物在恶劣气候时期幸存下来的区域

entries.definition: a structure that protects people from weather or danger

entries.definition: a safe holy place where people are protected

entries.definition: protection given by a state to a person from another country
entries.definitionCN: 政治庇护

normalIntro.en: Refuge is re- plus the Latin root fug, to flee: a place you flee back into.
normalIntro.cn: refuge 是前缀 re- 加上拉丁词根 fug（逃跑）：你可以「逃回去」的地方。

normal.en: Take refuge means to go somewhere safe.
normal.cn: take refuge 表示去某个安全的地方。

normal.en: A person who seeks refuge across a border becomes a refugee.
normal.cn: 越过边境寻求庇护的人就成了 refugee。

normal.en: The fug root also appears in fugitive, another word for someone fleeing.
normal.cn: 词根 fug 也出现在 fugitive 中，同样指逃跑的人。

normal.en: A wildlife refuge protects animals rather than people.
normal.cn: wildlife refuge 保护的是动物而不是人。

normal.en: Compare shelter: shelter is the physical cover, refuge stresses escape from danger.
normal.cn: 对比 shelter：shelter 强调遮挡物，refuge 强调躲避危险。

abstract.en: Picture a door shutting out the storm.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门把暴风雨挡在外面。

abstract.en: Imagine a warm kitchen at the end of a dark road.
abstract.cn: 想象黑暗道路尽头有一间温暖的厨房。

abstract.en: Think of a bird flying back into the nest.
abstract.cn: 想象一只鸟飞回巢里。

examples.en: The hikers took refuge from the rain under a rock.
examples.cn: 徒步者们在岩石下躲雨。

examples.en: Thousands of families sought refuge in the capital.
examples.cn: 数千个家庭到首都寻求庇护。

examples.en: The island is now a wildlife refuge for nesting birds.
examples.cn: 这座岛如今是鸟类筑巢的野生动物保护区。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞福居」——瑞气福气所居之处，就是安全的避难所；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回）+ fugere（逃跑）→ refugere（逃回）→ refugium（逃回之地）→ 古法语 refuge → 英语 refuge，核心义「逃回去以求安全的地方」。

sensesIntro.en: Refuge starts as the safe place you flee to, then names the protection itself, and widens to any shelter people turn to for relief.
sensesIntro.cn: refuge 先指你逃过去的安全地点，再指这种保护本身，最后扩展到人们求助以求放松的任何「避风港」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small hut that locks the storm outside.
core.cn: 核心意象：一间小屋把暴风雨关在门外。

branches.en: The shelter itself is the core sense.
branches.cn: 避难所本身是核心义项。

branches.en: The protection given is the abstract sense.
branches.cn: 给予的保护是抽象义项。

branches.en: Escape from stress is the figurative sense.
branches.cn: 逃离压力是比喻义项。

branches.en: A building and the safety it gives are almost the same thing.
branches.cn: 建筑物与它带来的安全几乎是一回事。

branches.en: Both political asylum and a quiet hobby keep trouble at a distance.
branches.cn: 政治庇护与安静的爱好都把麻烦挡在远处。

intro.en: Refuge is built from the Latin prefix re- and the root fug, to flee, with the noun ending -ium later lost.
intro.cn: refuge 由拉丁语前缀 re- 与词根 fug（逃跑）构成，名词词尾 -ium 后来脱落。

latinIntro.en: Latin refugere means to flee back, and refugium means the place one flees to.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 refugere 意为逃回，refugium 意为逃回去的地方。

items.example: The prefix re- suggests a return.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 表示返回。

items.example: Fugere gives the fleeing root of the family.
items.exampleCN: fugere 提供这个词族的「逃跑」词根。

items.example: Refugere combines re- and fugere.
items.exampleCN: refugere 由 re- 与 fugere 组合而成。

items.meaning: a place of fleeing back, a shelter
items.example: Refugium becomes Old French refuge.
items.exampleCN: refugium 演变为古法语 refuge。

items.meaning: forming nouns of place or state
items.meaningCN: 构成表示地点或状态的名词
items.example: The suffix -ium marks a place noun.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ium 标志地点名词。

items.example: Refuge keeps the sense of the Latin noun.
items.exampleCN: refuge 保留了拉丁名词的含义。

items.meaning: a person who receives an action
items.example: The suffix -ee forms refugee.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ee 构成 refugee。

items.meaning: a person who has fled for safety
items.example: Refugee names the person, not the place.
items.exampleCN: refugee 指人而不指地点。

latinEntries.meaning: a shelter, a place to flee to
latinEntries.example: Refugium is the direct source of refuge.
latinEntries.exampleCN: refugium 是 refuge 的直接来源。
fugere 也派生出了英语 fugitive。

latinEntries.example: Refugere is the verb behind the noun.
latinEntries.exampleCN: refugere 是名词背后的动词。

definition_zh: 可退款的；可退还的；可退税的；可返还的
definition_en: able to be paid back to the buyer or given back to the person who paid
core_image: 一笔钱从柜台那头流回付款人的口袋。
scene: 订机票时，页面上小字写着这张优惠票不能退款。When I booked the flight, the small print said the discount fare was not refundable.
sceneCN: 这里 refundable 是「可退款的」（第 2 个义项：被付款方退回）；句意：订机票时，小字写着打折票价不可退。场景要点：订单页、勾选框、被划掉的一行小字；对应第 2 个义项。

pos.zh: 可退款的；可退还的；可退税的；可返还的

derivatives.zh: 退款；退税；返还款项（动词与名词同形，名词重音在前）
退还；退款给某人（refund 加 -able 前的基础动作）
不可退款的（non- 表示否定，构成反义形式）
可退款性（-ability 抽象名词，多用于金融与合同文本）
（债券）再融资；换债（refund 的动名词，金融术语）

senses.title: Able to be given back by the buyer
senses.definition: of goods, able to be given back to the seller so that the buyer gets the money again
senses.definitionCN: 指商品可以退还给卖方，买方由此重新拿回钱
senses.example: Only unopened goods are refundable under this policy.
senses.exampleCN: 按此规定，只有未拆封的商品可以退还。
senses.why: Latin re- “back” plus fundere “to pour” pictures money poured back. Anything you can hand back for money is refundable.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 re-「回」加 fundere「倾倒」，画面是钱被倒回原处。凡是能交回去换回钱的东西，就是可退还的。

senses.title: Able to be repaid as money
senses.definition: of money, able to be paid back to the person who paid it, especially by an airline or a shop
senses.definitionCN: 指付款能够退还给付款人，尤其用于航空与零售
senses.example: The deposit is refundable if you cancel at least a week ahead.
senses.exampleCN: 提前至少一周取消，押金可以退。
senses.why: Once the image is money flowing back, the word easily describes the money itself rather than the thing.
senses.whyCN: 一旦意象落在「钱流回来」，这个词就自然描述钱本身，而不是商品。

senses.title: Able to be reclaimed from tax
senses.definition: of tax or credit, able to be paid back to the taxpayer even if no tax is owed
senses.definitionCN: 指税款或抵免可以退还给纳税人，即使其并不欠税
senses.example: The child allowance is a refundable tax credit in several countries.
senses.exampleCN: 在一些国家，子女津贴属于可退还的税收抵免。
senses.why: Tax systems reuse the word for credit that flows back as a cheque rather than only reducing a bill.
senses.whyCN: 税制把这个词挪用来指以支票形式返回到手的抵免，而不只是抵扣账单。

senses.title: In finance: returnable to holders
senses.titleCN: 金融中的可返还（再融资）
senses.definition: in finance, of funds or a loan, able to be returned to the original holders before the agreed date
senses.definitionCN: 在金融语境里，指资金或贷款可以约定日期之前返还原持有者
senses.example: Bonds that are refundable early let the issuer replace them with cheaper debt.
senses.exampleCN: 可提前赎回的债券让发行人能用更便宜的债务替换它。
senses.why: The “pour back” image also covers capital: money handed back to bondholders before maturity.
senses.whyCN: 「倒回去」的意象也覆盖资本：到期前把钱交还给债券持有人。

senses.title: Able to be reimbursed by an insurer
senses.definition: of costs, able to be paid back by an insurer or an organisation after the client has paid first
senses.definitionCN: 指费用先由客户垫付，之后可由保险机构或单位支付回来
senses.example: Prescription eye drops are refundable if your doctor certifies the need.
senses.exampleCN: 如果医生出具需要证明，处方眼药水可以报销。
senses.why: Insurance adds a first payer: the client pays the counter, then the money pours back later.
senses.whyCN: 保险多了「先垫付的一方」：客户先在柜台付钱，之后钱再倒回给他。

senses.title: Able to be repaid on a policy
senses.definition: of an insurance policy, designed to return part of the premiums to the holder if no claim is made
senses.definitionCN: 指保险产品把部分保费返还给持有人，前提是没有发生理赔
senses.example: He chose a refundable policy that returns half the premium after ten years.
senses.exampleCN: 他选了可返本的保单，十年后返还一半保费。
senses.why: A policy is refundable when the direction of flow reverses: premiums come back to the holder.
senses.whyCN: 当资金流动方向反转、保费回到持有人手上时，就产生保单方面的「可返本」：钱倒回付款人。

senses.title: Eligible for repayment in law
senses.definition: in legal and contractual writing, entitled to get money back under the terms agreed
senses.definitionCN: 在法律与合同文本中，按约定条款有权要回款项
senses.example: Any amount paid after termination is refundable on written request.
senses.exampleCN: 解除合同后支付的任何款项，经书面申请可以退回。
senses.why: Law turns the physical-flow image into an entitlement: a right to have money poured back.
senses.whyCN: 法律把物理上的流向变成一种权利：有权让钱倒回来。

senses.title: Able to be restored to the owner
senses.definition: often in the negative, of something abstract such as dignity or a deposit of trust, able to be given back
senses.definitionCN: 常用于否定式，指尊严、信任等抽象的东西可以交还回去
senses.example: Goodwill once spent is never fully refundable.
senses.exampleCN: 信誉一旦花掉，就永远无法全额退回。
senses.why: The image generalises: anything given can be imagined as paid, and then poured back to its owner.
senses.whyCN: 意象被泛化：凡是给出去的东西都可以想象成付了款，然后倒回原主手上。

intro.en: Refundable is a modern adjective on refund, itself built from Latin re- “back” and fundere “to pour”. The picture is liquid pouring back to its owner.
intro.cn: refundable 是加在 refund 上的现代形容词，而 refund 由拉丁语 re-「回」与 fundere「倾倒」构成。画面是液体倒回原主手中。

items.en: Fundere “to pour, to shed” is the base; the past participle füsus gives the stem seen in refund and refundable.
items.cn: fundere「倒、流」是基础词，其过去分词 füsus 提供了 refund 与 refundable 中的词干。

items.en: Refundere meant “to pour back, to pour out again”, used of liquids returning to their vessel.
items.cn: refundere 意为「倒回、再次倒出」，用于液体流回原容器。

items.en: Old French refunder is recorded mainly in legal and administrative use.
items.cn: 古法语 refunder 主要见于法律行政文献。

items.en: English records refund as a verb meaning to pay back money and as a noun for the money paid back.
items.cn: 英语在中古时期记录 refund，既作动词表示「还钱」，也作名词表示「退回的钱」。

items.en: Refundable appears in commercial and legal writing to mark tickets, deposits, and fares that may be repaid.
items.cn: refundable 在近代商业与法律文本中出现，用来标记可退款的车票、押金与票价。

items.en: Twentieth-century tax and insurance law extends the word to refundable credits, refundable policies, and early refunding of bonds.
items.cn: 二十世纪的税收与保险法规把该词扩展到可退还抵免、可返本保单以及债券提前再融资。

note.en: The first group is the refund family; the second marks words that promise your money back from a different angle.
note.cn: 第一组是 refund 词族；第二组从不同角度标出「保证退钱」的近义词。

entries.definition: not able to be paid back. It is the tight opposite and sits on every discount fare notice.
entries.definitionCN: 不可退的。它是最常用的反义形式，打折票价通知上处处可见。

entries.definition: the act of paying money back. The suffix -ment names the action rather than the possibility.
entries.definitionCN: 退款行为。-ment 后缀指动作，而非「可能性」。

entries.definition: the practice of replacing old bonds with new ones, a technical finance use of the same word.
entries.definitionCN: 用新债券替换旧债券的做法，是同一词在金融上的技术用法。

entries.definition: able to be paid back for costs already paid, used mainly of travel and business expenses.
entries.definitionCN: 已垫付费用可被返还，主要用于差旅与业务开支。

entries.definition: of goods or packaging, able to be sent back to the seller, often with no money involved.
entries.definitionCN: 指商品或包装可以寄回卖方，常常不涉及退钱。

entries.definition: of a loan, required to be paid back by the borrower to the lender.
entries.definitionCN: 指贷款须由借款人偿还给放款人。

entries.definition: of vouchers or points, able to be exchanged for goods or cash.
entries.definitionCN: 指代金券或积分可以兑换成商品或现金。

normalIntro.en: Real parts only: Latin re- “back” and fundere “to pour”, giving refund, refundable, and non-refundable.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：拉丁语 re-「回」与 fundere「倾倒」，由此得到 refund、refundable 与 non-refundable。

normal.en: The re- in refundable is Latin “back”; the word literally offers to pour money back.
normal.cn: refundable 里的 re- 是拉丁语「回」；这个词字面就是把钱倒回来。

normal.en: Refund as a noun is stressed first; as a verb it is stressed second.
normal.cn: refund 作名词重音在前；作动词重音在后。

normal.en: The opposite is usually the tighter word: non-refundable.
normal.cn: 反义词通常是更紧凑的 non-refundable。

normal.en: Refundable tax credit means the government pays you even when you owe nothing.
normal.cn: refundable tax credit 意味着即使你一分不欠，政府也会打钱给你。

normal.en: Compare returnable: returnable is about sending the thing back, refundable is about getting the money back.
normal.cn: 对比 returnable：returnable 说的是把东西寄回，refundable 说的是把钱拿回。

abstract.en: Imagine money flowing down a counter and then back up into your hand.
abstract.cn: 想象钱从柜台流下去，又倒流回自己手里。

abstract.en: A stamped ticket once torn open stops being refundable at the same second.
abstract.cn: 一张盖章的车票被撕开的那一秒，它就不再可退了。

abstract.en: Every refundable promise secretly spends the money of the seller for a while.
abstract.cn: 每一份可退的承诺，都在一段时间里悄悄花着卖方的钱。

examples.en: Tickets bought online are refundable up to forty-eight hours before departure.
examples.cn: 网上购买的票在出发前四十八小时内可退。

examples.en: The studio charges a non-refundable booking fee.
examples.cn: 工作室收取一笔不可退的预约费。

examples.en: Please check whether the deposit is refundable before you sign.
examples.cn: 签字之前请先确认押金是否可退。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞放得」——瑞字票据能放回你手里，钱也倒回你的口袋，就是 refundable 可退款的；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回）加 fundere（倒、流）→ refundere（倒回、再倒出）→ 古法语 refunder → 英语 refund（退还；退款）→ refundable（可退的），核心是钱倒流回付款人的手里。

sensesIntro.en: Refundable starts with goods you can hand back, then money you can get back, then tax, loans, insurance, and finally anything abstract that can be restored.
sensesIntro.cn: refundable 先从可以交回的商品说起，再指可以拿回的钱，之后扩展到税款、贷款、保险，最后落到任何可以归还的抽象之物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: money poured back into the hand of the payer.
core.cn: 核心意象：钱倒流回付款人手里。

branches.en: Goods: the object goes back, and the money comes back with it.
branches.cn: 商品：东西退回，钱也跟着回来。

branches.en: Money: a fare or deposit is refundable when the payer can reclaim it.
branches.cn: 钱：票价或押金可退，指付款人能要回来。

branches.en: Rules: tax credits and contract terms turn repayment into a legal right.
branches.cn: 规则：可退还抵免与合同条款把还款变成一项法定权利。

branches.en: Finance: bonds and policies are refundable when capital flows back to the holders.
branches.cn: 金融：债券与保单可返，指资本流回持有人。

branches.en: Wider circle: insurers pay costs back, and even goodwill can be spoken of as refundable.
branches.cn: 更广：保险会报销费用，连信誉也能说成可退。

intro.en: Refundable is refund plus the suffix -able, and refund is re- plus fundere, to pour. Non- gives the negative form.
intro.cn: refundable 是 refund 加后缀 -able，而 refund 是 re- 加 fundere（倒）。加非-前缀否定式换成 non-。

latinIntro.en: The Latin core is fundere “to pour”; re- means “back”; refundere means “pour back”. Refundable is an English-built adjective on that base.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语核心是 fundere「倒」；re- 意为「回」；refundere 意为「倒回」。refundable 是在这基础上由英语构成的后缀形容词。

items.example: Re- adds the idea of going back to the payer.
items.exampleCN: re- 加入「回到付款人」的意思。

items.example: Fundere supplies the pouring image behind refund.
items.exampleCN: fundere 提供 refund 背后的「倾倒」意象。

items.example: Refundere is the direct Latin parent of refund.
items.exampleCN: refundere 是 refund 的拉丁语直接来源。

items.example: The shop will refund your postage.
items.exampleCN: 商店会退还你的邮费。

items.example: The refund reached her account in three days.
items.exampleCN: 退款三天内到了她的账户。

items.meaning: that can be, fit to be
items.example: The suffix -able turns refund into refundable.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -able 把 refund 变成 refundable。

items.example: Only the basic fare is refundable.
items.exampleCN: 只有基本票价是可退的。

items.example: Non- forms the standard negative non-refundable.
items.exampleCN: non- 构成标准否定式 non-refundable。

items.meaning: not able to be paid back
items.example: The visa fee is non-refundable.
items.exampleCN: 签证费不可退。

items.meaning: the quality of being able to be
items.example: The suffix -ability builds the abstract noun refundability.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ability 构成抽象名词 refundability。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 被倒出的（fundere 的过去分词）

definition_zh: 反驳；驳倒；证明……错误；否认
definition_en: to prove that a statement, argument, or theory is wrong
core_image: 一只手掌把对方的话整个推回去，推到说话人面前。
scene: 研讨会上，她用两组实验数据反驳了那条流行的假设。At the seminar she refuted the popular hypothesis with two sets of data.
sceneCN: 这里 refute 是「驳倒、证明有误」（第 1 个义项：证明某个说法是错的）；句意：她在研讨会上用两组数据驳倒了那条流行假设。场景要点：投影幕上的图表、被圈红的数字、台下点头的人群；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 反驳；驳倒；证明……错误；否认

derivatives.zh: 反驳；驳斥；驳倒（-ation 构成动作名词）
可被反驳的；可证伪的（-able 表示可能性）
无法反驳的；无可辩驳的（in- 的异体 ir- 表否定）
无可辩驳地（irrefutable 加 -ly）
反驳者；驳斥者（-er 表示施动的人）

senses.title: To prove a statement wrong
senses.definition: to prove by evidence or argument that a statement or theory is wrong
senses.definitionCN: 用证据或论证证明某个说法或理论是错的
senses.example: New fossils refuted the theory that the birds were flightless.
senses.exampleCN: 新的化石推翻了这些鸟不会飞的学说。
senses.why: Latin refutare joins re- “back” and a root meaning “to strike or beat”. To refute is to beat the argument back with proof.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 refutare 由 re-「回」与表示「击打」的词根构成。反驳就是用证据把对方的论点击打回去。

senses.title: To deny a charge
senses.definition: to say firmly that an accusation or rumour is not true
senses.definitionCN: 坚决表示某项指责或传闻不实
senses.example: The minister refuted the allegations at a press conference.
senses.exampleCN: 部长在记者会上否认了这些指控。
senses.why: When the charge is personal, you push back not with data but with a flat denial: the same backward motion without the proof.
senses.whyCN: 当指责指向个人时，推回去靠的不是数据，而是一句坚决的否认：还是那个往回推的动作，只是没有证据作弹药。

senses.title: To disprove by experiment
senses.definition: in science, to show that a hypothesis fails a test, so that it is rejected
senses.definitionCN: 在科学中表明某个假说未通过检验，因而被拒绝
senses.example: Philosophers argue that no universal law can be fully refuted by a single result.
senses.exampleCN: 哲学家争论说，一条普遍定律无法被单一结果完全证伪。
senses.why: Science formalises the beat-back: a failed prediction strikes the hypothesis down, and the field calls that a refutation.
senses.whyCN: 科学把「打回去」程式化：预测失败就一点命中假说，学界把这一过程叫作反驳或证伪。

senses.title: To overcome in debate
senses.definition: to defeat an opponent or a case in debate so that it no longer stands
senses.definitionCN: 在论辩中击败对手或论点，使其无法成立
senses.example: Her opening statement refuted every point of the prosecution case.
senses.exampleCN: 她的开场陈述逐条驳倒了控方的论点。
senses.why: The reflex is always back: the opponent comes forward with a case, and the rebuttal throws it away from the table.
senses.whyCN: 这个反射动作永远是朝外的：对手把论点送到桌面上来，反驳再把它扔回去。

senses.title: To show a model to be invalid
senses.definition: of a calculation, model, or method, to show that its results do not hold
senses.definitionCN: 指计算、模型或方法的结果经不起检验
senses.example: The audit refuted the cost estimate used in the bid.
senses.exampleCN: 审计推翻了投标中所用的成本估算。
senses.why: A model is a claim that it works. When results contradict it, the claim is beaten back the same way.
senses.whyCN: 模型本身就是「它有效」这一说法。结果一旦与之矛盾，这个说法同样被击打回去。

senses.title: To answer a falsehood
senses.definition: of a rumour or false story, to show that it is not true and stop it spreading
senses.definitionCN: 指传闻或不实的说法被证明为假并因此止住传播
senses.example: The health agency refuted the rumour that the vaccine altered genes.
senses.exampleCN: 卫生部门辟谣了疫苗会改变基因的传闻。
senses.why: A rumour spreads forward; refuting it is pushing the story back to its source, with facts attached.
senses.whyCN: 传闻向前传播；辟谣就是带着事实把这个故事推回它的源头。

senses.title: To reject a supposed proof
senses.definition: in logic and mathematics, to show that a supposed proof contains an error
senses.definitionCN: 在逻辑与数学中表明某个所谓证明含有错误
senses.example: A single flaw in the second step refutes the whole demonstration.
senses.exampleCN: 第二步的一处漏洞就足以推翻整个论证。
senses.why: A proof is a chain; striking out one link makes the chain come back in pieces, and that is the refutation.
senses.whyCN: 证明是一条链；打断其中一环，链子就会整段散回来，这就是驳倒。

senses.title: To quote against a claim
senses.definition: in older rhetoric, to cite a different opinion to set against one, showing it is wrong that way
senses.definitionCN: 在较早的修辞学中，引用不同意见与之对照，从而指出前者是错的
senses.example: The essayist refuted the popular view by quoting an older writer who had seen the opposite.
senses.exampleCN: 散文家引用一位见过相反情形的前人，驳斥了流行看法。
senses.why: Even a quotation can be the weapon: you bring another voice forward and it strikes back against the claim on the table.
senses.whyCN: 连引文也能当武器：你把另一个声音拿到台前，它就会朝桌上的说法打回去。

intro.en: Refute comes from Latin refutare; its exact internal structure is uncertain, but the traditional account joins re- “back” with a verb of striking, as in beating an argument back.
intro.cn: refute 来自拉丁语 refutare；其内部结构来源不确定，但传统解释把 re-「回」与表示击打的动词相连，即把论点打回去。

items.en: Refutare meant “to repel, check, disprove”. The traditional analysis is probably re- “back” plus a form of the verb futare “to beat”.
items.cn: refutare 意为「击退、制止、驳斥」。传统分析认为大约是 re-「回」加上动词 futare「击打」的某种形式。

items.en: The futare link is uncertain: some scholars leave the second element unexplained and note that the word may be pre-Roman in origin.
items.cn: 与 futare 的联系来源不确定：有学者把第二个成分视为未解，并指出该词也许是前罗马时期的遗留。

items.en: Old French refuter kept the sense of repelling an argument by proof.
items.cn: 古法语 refuter 保留了用证据击退论点的含义。

items.en: English refute is recorded from the sixteenth century, first in scholarly and legal debate.
items.cn: 英语 refute 在十六世纪已有记录，最初见于学术与法律论辩。

items.en: Nineteenth-century handbooks start to mark the looser use, deny without proving, as careless.
items.cn: 十九世纪的写作手册开始指出，「未经证明就否认」的宽松用法不够严谨。

items.en: Modern science and philosophy make refutable and irrefutable technical words for tests and proofs.
items.cn: 现代科学与哲学把 refutable 与 irrefutable 变成描述检验与证明的技术词。

note.en: The first group is the refute family and its Latin parent; the second separates the ways of saying a statement is wrong.
note.cn: 第一组是 refute 词族与它的拉丁语来源；第二组按「说一个说法错」的不同方式来区分近义词。

entries.definition: the Latin verb behind refute, recorded in the sense of checking or disproving a claim.
entries.definitionCN: refute 背后的拉丁动词，用于制止或驳斥某种主张。

entries.definition: the act or result of proving something wrong. It is the noun of refute.
entries.definitionCN: 证明某事有误的行为或结果，是 refute 的名词。

entries.definition: able to be shown wrong. It names a possibility, not a result.
entries.definitionCN: 可以被证明有误的。它说的是可能性，不是结果。

entries.definition: impossible to deny. The negative prefix ir- makes it the opposite of refutable.
entries.definitionCN: 无法否认的。否定前缀 ir- 使它成为 refutable 的反面。

entries.definition: to show by evidence that something is false. It is the closest word, naming the proof directly.
entries.definitionCN: 用证据表明某事为假。它最接近，直接点出「证明」。

entries.definition: to answer an argument with a reply that contradicts it, common in law and debate.
entries.definitionCN: 针对某个论证给出相反的答复，常见于法律与辩论。

entries.definition: to state that something is not true, without necessarily proving it.
entries.definitionCN: 宣称某事不实，并不一定加以证明。

entries.definition: to say that a charge or statement is false. It is pure saying, with no proof required.
entries.definitionCN: 声称指控或说法不实。纯属表态，不要求证据。

normalIntro.en: Real parts only: Latin re- “back” plus a disputed second element, giving refute, refutation, refutable, and irrefutable.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：拉丁语 re-「回」加上一个来源有争议的第二成分，由此得到 refute、refutation、refutable 与 irrefutable。

normal.en: The re- in refute is “back”: a refutation throws a claim back at the person who made it.
normal.cn: refute 里的 re- 是「回」：驳斥就是把主张扔回提出它的人面前。

normal.en: Refutable and irrefutable are the two handles: can be shown wrong, and cannot.
normal.cn: refutable 与 irrefutable 是两个把手：能被证明错，与不能被证明错。

normal.en: In science a hypothesis must be refutable, that is, testable in a way that could fail.
normal.cn: 在科学中假说必须可被反驳，也就是能用可能失败的方式检验。

normal.en: Refutation is the noun; rebuttal is the lawyer cousin of the same action.
normal.cn: refutation 是名词；rebuttal 是律师口中同一动作的堂兄弟。

normal.en: Refute means prove wrong, so pair it with evidence, not merely with an opinion.
normal.cn: refute 意为证明有误，因此它常与证据连用，而不只是与看法连用。

abstract.en: Picture an open palm stopping an argument in mid-air and sending it back.
abstract.cn: 想象一只张开的手把半空中的论点挡住，又按原路送回去。

abstract.en: A denial is a wall built in a second; a refutation is a wall with bricks of proof.
abstract.cn: 否认是一秒钟砌好的墙；驳斥则是用证据砖块垒起来的墙。
