definition_zh: 欢欣；高兴；使……欢喜；因……而庆祝
definition_en: to feel or show great joy, or to make someone feel great joy
core_image: 敲门声响起，屋里的人一下从椅子上跳起来
scene: 远方寄来录取函的那天，全家围着桌子又笑又哭。The whole family rejoiced when the letter from overseas finally arrived.
sceneCN: 这里 rejoice 是「欢欣、高兴」（第 1 个义项：感到并表现出极大的喜悦）；句意：远方的信终于寄到，全家人一起欢欣鼓舞。从椅子上跳起来的画面，就是核心意象。

derivatives.zh: rejoice 加 -ing 构成的名词，义为「欢庆；欢欣」
joy 是 rejoice 词义的核心部分，义为「快乐；喜悦」
与 rejoice 共享 joy 词干的形容词，义为「充满喜悦的」

senses.title: To feel and show great joy
senses.definition: to feel or show a strong and open happiness about something
senses.definitionCN: 对某事感到并公开表现出强烈的快乐
senses.example: They rejoiced at the news of his safe return.
senses.exampleCN: 他们听到他平安归来都很欢欣。
senses.why: The root word is the verb to joy, so rejoicing is making the core idea of joy strong and outward.
senses.whyCN: 这个词的底子是表示「欢乐」的动词，rejoice 就是把「乐」加足、并且表现出来，所以首先就是「欢欣、高兴」。

senses.title: To celebrate something as a group
senses.definition: to mark a good event with shared celebration
senses.definitionCN: 大家聚在一起为一件好事而庆祝
senses.example: The town rejoiced when the bridge was finally rebuilt.
senses.exampleCN: 桥终于修好时，全城一片欢庆。
senses.why: Joy that is shared needs an outward form, and rejoicing has long carried a festive, often public tone.
senses.whyCN: 共同的喜悦需要有外在形式，rejoice 从早期就带着节庆、甚至公开的性质，所以从「心里高兴」自然长成「集体欢庆」。

senses.title: To make another person glad
senses.definition: to bring happiness to someone else
senses.definitionCN: 让另一个人感到快乐
senses.example: The children rejoiced their parents with a handmade gift.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们用一件亲手做的礼物让父母满心欢喜。
senses.why: English uses the re- prefix to express a backward direction, so the same word can point its joy toward another person.
senses.whyCN: 这个前缀在早期英语里有「往回、朝向」的意味，于是同一个词可以把喜悦「投」向别人，由自己乐变成使别人乐。

senses.title: Joy in a religious setting
senses.definition: to give thanks and express gladness in a formal or religious setting
senses.definitionCN: 在正式或宗教场合中表达感恩与喜悦
senses.example: The congregation rejoiced at the harvest service.
senses.exampleCN: 会众在丰收礼拜上欢欣感恩。
senses.why: Bible translations helped fix the word in religious language, where gladness is an act of praise rather than a private feeling.
senses.whyCN: 早期英语圣经译本让这个词扎根于宗教语言，那里的喜悦是一种颂赞行为，而不是私人的情绪，于是有了庄严的宗教义。

senses.title: To delight in having something or someone
senses.definition: to take deep pleasure in a possession, a person or an achievement
senses.definitionCN: 对拥有的东西、身边的人或取得的成就感到深深的快乐
senses.example: She rejoiced in her new freedom.
senses.exampleCN: 她为自己的新自由而欣喜。
senses.why: Joy attaches itself to the cause of it, so the preposition pattern names the source of gladness.
senses.whyCN: 喜悦总是附着在引起它的东西上，rejoice 后的介词（at、in、over）就是要指出快乐的来源，于是长出「因某事而欣喜」这一义项。

senses.title: To be glad about someone else success
senses.definition: to feel glad about the good fortune of another person
senses.definitionCN: 为他人的好运或成功而感到高兴
senses.example: We rejoiced that she had passed the exam.
senses.exampleCN: 她通过了考试，我们都为她高兴。
senses.why: The feeling can be triggered by anything good, including the good of others, and rejoice followed by that is what grammar records.
senses.whyCN: 快乐的触发点可以是任何好事，包括别人的好事，这个义项就是把 rejoice 接到 that 从句上、表示为他人庆幸，是同一情绪向外的延伸。

senses.title: Joy expressed by the whole landscape
senses.definition: in literature, to say that nature, objects or places seem full of delight
senses.definitionCN: 在文学中形容自然、物件或地方仿佛充满喜悦
senses.example: The hills rejoiced in the spring light.
senses.exampleCN: 群山在春光里欣然舒展。
senses.why: Personal joy can be projected onto a setting in poetry, so trees and rivers appear to rejoice alongside people.
senses.whyCN: 诗人把人的欢快投射到景物上，让树木、河流也与人同乐，这种拟人用法就是源于「喜悦人人共有」的心理投射。

senses.title: Rejoicing at another person misfortune
senses.definition: an unholy or improper gladness about bad fortune that has befallen others
senses.definitionCN: 对他人遭遇的不幸感到不应有的高兴
senses.example: A fair person will not rejoice at another disaster.
senses.exampleCN: 公正的人不会因他人遭难而幸灾乐祸。
senses.why: The same emotion can be aimed at a wrong object, and English marks that misuse with a negative phrase about the wrong kind of rejoicing.
senses.whyCN: 同样的喜悦对象错了就变味，英语用「有罪的高兴」这个说法专门标出它，于是 rejoice 也多了一条「幸灾乐祸」的负面用法。

intro.en: Rejoice comes from Old French rejoiss-, the stem of rejoir, built in French from re- plus joir to be glad.
intro.cn: rejoice 来自古法语 rejoir 的词干 rejoiss-，由法语前缀 re- 与 joir（快乐）构成。

items.en: The distant source is Latin gaudere, to be glad, which also gave English gaudy and the name Gaudenzio; the Old French joir belongs to this family.
items.cn: 更远的源头是拉丁语 gaudere（高兴），英语的 gaudy 与名字 Gaudenzio 也出自它，古法语 joir 属于这一词族。

items.en: Old French built rejoir from the intensive prefix re- and joir, to be glad, giving the sense of being very glad.
items.cn: 古法语用加强语气的前缀 re- 加 joir（快乐）构成 rejoir，表示「非常高兴」。

items.en: The present participle stem rejoiss- was taken into English, and the verb appears in Middle English with a spelling still close to rejoise.
items.cn: 英语借入的是它的现在分词词干 rejoiss-，这个动词在中古英语出现时，拼写还接近 rejoise。

items.en: The word is recorded in English from the fourteenth century and would probably not exist in this form if English had borrowed the Latin verb directly.
items.cn: rejoice 在十四世纪已见于英语。如果英语是直接从拉丁语拿这个词，今天大概不会是这个拼写。

items.en: The final spelling settled on the model of words ending in -oice, but the pronunciation stayed closer to joice.
items.cn: 十六世纪起，拼写按 -oice 结尾的词定型，读音却仍接近 joice。

items.en: The word kept the joyful senses of Old French and added a formal and religious register through Bible translations.
items.cn: 这个词保留了古法语的欢欣义，又借圣经译本获得正式与宗教的语体色彩。

note.en: Rejoice means to be greatly glad; it is close to joy and delight, works like celebrate in group settings, and only looks like reject or rejoice at first glance.
note.cn: rejoice 表示非常快乐，跟 joy、delight 亲近，在集体场合又接近 celebrate；拼写上还容易和 reject、rejoinder 混淆。

entries.definitionCN: 同根词：rejoice 词义的核心词干，名词义为快乐；喜悦

entries.definition: the act or state of being glad
entries.definitionCN: 派生形式：rejoice 加 -ing 得到的名词，义为欢庆；欢欣

entries.definition: to refuse to accept

entries.definition: to mark a special event with enjoyable activities
entries.definitionCN: 近义：用活动纪念喜事，强调外在礼仪与聚会

entries.definition: to take great pleasure in something
entries.definitionCN: 近义：感到极大愉悦，常接 in，语气比 rejoice 轻快

entries.definition: to enjoy oneself in a lively and noisy way

normalIntro.en: Rejoice has joy at its heart: re- makes the gladness stronger, and the spelling keeps -oice like voice.
normalIntro.cn: rejoice 的心里装的是 joy：re- 把「乐」加足，末尾拼写像 voice，写成 -oice。

normal.en: The joi- part is the voice of joy.
normal.cn: 中间的 joi- 就是 joy 的变形，发音也接近。

normal.en: Rejoice is the verb, rejoicing is the noun of gladness.
normal.cn: rejoice 是动词，加上 -ing 的 rejoicing 是「欢庆」的名词。

normal.en: We rejoice at news, in something we love, or over a win.
normal.cn: 常见搭配：rejoice at 消息、rejoice in 喜爱之物、rejoice over 胜利。

normal.en: This verb arrived through Old French, not straight from Latin.
normal.cn: 这个词是经由古法语进入英语的，不是直接从拉丁语借来。

normal.en: The spelling ends like voice, which is how you say it aloud.
normal.cn: 末尾拼写与 voice 一样，读出来正是「沃伊斯」的尾音。

abstract.en: Picture someone throwing their arms up the moment good news arrives.
abstract.cn: 想象好消息一到，有人立刻高举双臂。

abstract.en: Picture a town square full of cheering neighbours.
abstract.cn: 想象一座小镇广场上都是欢呼的邻居。

abstract.en: Picture a candle of joy being lit and passed from hand to hand.
abstract.cn: 想象一支喜悦的蜡烛被点燃，从一双手传到另一双手。

examples.en: The whole village rejoiced when the drought finally broke.
examples.cn: 旱情终于缓解时，全村人都欢欣鼓舞。

examples.en: We should not rejoice at another person failure.
examples.cn: 我们不该因为别人失败而幸灾乐祸。

examples.en: Her letter of good news made the family rejoice for days.
examples.cn: 她那封报喜的信让全家人高兴了好几天。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞觉伊斯」—— 拆开看是「锐觉」加「伊斯」，想象一听到好消息就敏锐地跳起来高喊「伊斯」；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 gaudere（高兴）→ 古法语 joir（快乐）加前缀 re- 构成 rejoir（非常高兴）→ 词干 rejoiss- → 中古英语 rejoise → 现代英语 rejoice，核心义「把快乐表现出来」。

sensesIntro.en: Rejoice moves from the simple feeling of great joy to shared celebration, to causing joy in others, to delight in what one has, and finally to ironic or improper gladness.
sensesIntro.cn: rejoice 从单纯的「非常高兴」出发，发展为集体欢庆、使别人欢喜、因所爱而欣喜，最后带上「幸灾乐祸」这类反讽用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: doors open and people leap up, both arms raised, at the sound of good news.
core.cn: 核心意象：好消息一来，门被推开，众人从座位上跳起来高举双臂。

branches.en: The feeling and its cause: rejoicing is being glad, and it is glad about something.
branches.cn: 感受与起因：rejoice 是一种高兴，而且总是因某物而高兴。

branches.en: When the joy spreads outward it becomes celebration with other people, and in literature with the whole landscape.
branches.cn: 当喜悦向外扩散，就成了与他人一起的欢庆，文学中还会波及整片景物。

branches.en: The verb can also point its joy at someone else: gladness that makes others glad.
branches.cn: 动词也可以把喜悦投向别人：让自己的快乐变成让别人快乐。

branches.en: In religious language gladness takes a formal shape and becomes praise and thanksgiving.
branches.cn: 在宗教语境里，喜悦被赋予正式的形式，成为颂赞与感恩。

branches.en: The same emotion reaches its warmest point in joy for others and its coldest in joy at their misfortune.
branches.cn: 同一种情绪在最暖处是为他人高兴，在最冷处就变成见他遭难而高兴。

intro.en: Rejoice is a French-built verb whose heart is joy, with the prefix re- intensifying the gladness; English kept the pattern re- plus a joy word.
intro.cn: rejoice 是一个在法语中构成的动词，核心是「乐」，前缀 re- 加强了这份快乐；英语保留了 re- 加「乐」这个词形的构词方式。

latinIntro.en: The deeper Latin source is gaudere, to be glad, which also lies behind joy and gaudy.
latinIntro.cn: 更深层的拉丁语源头是 gaudere（高兴），joy 与 gaudy 的背后也有它。

items.example: Re- makes the gladness of the older verb stronger.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 使原本的「快乐」更强烈。

items.example: Joir is the gladness at the centre of the word.
items.exampleCN: joir 是这个词中心的「乐」。

items.example: Rejoir is the direct ancestor of the English verb.
items.exampleCN: rejoir 是英语这个动词的直接祖先。

items.example: Joy is the noun the verb carries inside it.
items.exampleCN: joy 是这个动词内含的名词。

items.example: Rejoice is the verb formed on the French stem.
items.exampleCN: rejoice 是在法语词干上形成的英语动词。

items.meaningCN: 动作或结果的名词后缀
items.example: The suffix -ing forms rejoicing.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ing 构成 rejoicing。

items.example: The suffix -ous forms joyous from joy.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ous 把 joy 变成 joyous。

items.example: The suffix -ful forms joyful.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ful 构成 joyful。

definition_zh: 反驳；回嘴；回应；（法律）被告的答辩
definition_en: a reply to an argument or a criticism, often a sharp one; in law, the answer made by a defendant
core_image: 一方刚说完，另一方立刻抬手回了一句
scene: 辩论结束后，记者追问那句尖锐的反驳是什么意思。The journalist asked what the lawyer meant by his sharp rejoinder.
sceneCN: 这里 rejoinder 是「反驳、回嘴」（第 1 个义项：对某项论证或批评的回答，常带锋芒）；句意：记者追问律师那句尖锐的反驳究竟是什么意思。抬手立刻回话的画面，就是核心意象。

pos.zh: （法律）被告的答辩；第二次答辩

derivatives.zh: 词根动词，义为「回答；反驳」，rejoinder 由它加表示施事者的后缀构成
在 rejoinder 前加表示「在之上」的前缀构成的法律术语，指「对被告答辩的再答复」

senses.title: A sharp reply to an argument
senses.definition: a reply to a statement or a criticism, usually quick and sometimes sharp
senses.definitionCN: 对别人的说法或批评作出的回答，往往迅速且带有锋芒
senses.example: He had a neat rejoinder for every objection.
senses.exampleCN: 每一个反对意见他都有干脆的反驳。
senses.why: The word is built from re- back and the French verb for joining, so a rejoinder is the answer that is joined on to what another person said.
senses.whyCN: 这个词由「往回」的前缀与法语中表示「接合」的动词组成，rejoinder 就是紧跟对方那句话「接上去」的回答，所以首先指反驳与回嘴。

senses.title: A lawyer response to the opposite side
senses.definition: in legal procedure, the answer by which a defendant replies to the plaintiff or to a further stage of the case
senses.definitionCN: 在法律程序中，被告对原告主张或案件后来的某一阶段作出的答复
senses.example: The court set a date for filing the rejoinder.
senses.exampleCN: 法院为提交答辩状定了日期。
senses.why: The common-law pleading system asked each side to answer the last move, and the defendant answer was called the rejoinder.
senses.whyCN: 普通法系的诉答制度要求每一方逐一回答对方的上一步，被告作出的这一步答复就被命名为 rejoinder，因此这个词有了专门的法律名词用法。

senses.title: A witty or clever reply
senses.definition: a clever, often humorous answer that turns a remark back on the speaker
senses.definitionCN: 巧妙、常带幽默地回答，常把话头转回说话者身上
senses.example: Her witty rejoinder drew laughter from the room.
senses.exampleCN: 她机智的回应引来满堂笑声。
senses.why: A reply that must be made on the spot rewards speed and wit, so the word is often used for a good comeback.
senses.whyCN: 回嘴必须当场接上，速度与机智就成了重点，于是这个词常用来称赞一句漂亮的回击，长出了「机敏回应」这一义项。

senses.title: A formal published reply
senses.definition: a written answer to an article, a letter or a public statement, often published
senses.definitionCN: 对文章、信件或公开声明的书面回答，常公开发表
senses.example: The journal printed a long rejoinder from the author.
senses.exampleCN: 期刊刊出了作者一篇很长的答复。
senses.why: When the answer is written down and shared, the quick reply of conversation becomes a formal printed response.
senses.whyCN: 当回答被写下来、公之于众，对话中的即时应答就变成了正式的书面答复，这是同一动作从口语走向文本的变化。

senses.title: A reply that shows how the matter stands
senses.definition: in some court systems, the stage at which a defendant answers the plaintiff reply, or the document filed at that stage
senses.definitionCN: 在部分法院体系中，被告对原告答复作出回应的阶段，或在该阶段提交的文件
senses.example: The pleadings closed after the rejoinder was filed.
senses.exampleCN: 答辩状提交后，诉答程序即告结束。
senses.why: Common-law pleadings moved step by step, so the name came to mark one precise stage of a written exchange.
senses.whyCN: 普通法的诉答程序一步一步推进，于是这个词也被用来指称书面往来中一个精确的阶段，成为程序上的专名。

senses.title: Any answer in a back-and-forth exchange
senses.definition: a response in a series of exchanges, such as letters, talks or a debate
senses.definitionCN: 在信件、谈判或辩论等一连串往来中作出的回答
senses.example: His rejoinder to her letter closed the dispute.
senses.exampleCN: 他对她来信的回复结束了这场纠纷。
senses.why: The core idea of joining back fits any exchange, so the noun widened to name the answer in a sequence of exchanges.
senses.whyCN: 「接回去」的核心意思适用于任何一来一往的交流，所以这个词扩展成泛指一连串往来中的那一次答复，语气也随之中立化。

senses.title: A reply that echoes the first remark
senses.definition: a reply that picks up a word or a phrase from the first speaker and turns it against them
senses.definitionCN: 接过对方话里的词或短语并反过来回敬对方的那种回答
senses.example: His rejoinder repeated her phrase with dry irony.
senses.exampleCN: 他的回敬重复了她的措辞，带着淡淡的反讽。
senses.why: Joining a reply onto the first remark is literal when the words themselves are lifted and handed back.
senses.whyCN: 当回答直接把对方用过的词句「接」过来再送回去时，「接上」就变成了字面意义上的重复回敬，于是有了修辞上的用法。

senses.title: A defensive answer to criticism
senses.definition: a response made to defend oneself against an accusation or a charge in public
senses.definitionCN: 在公开场合面对指责或指控时为自辩而作出的回答
senses.example: The minister offered a short rejoinder to the charges.
senses.exampleCN: 部长对这些指控作了简短的辩解。
senses.why: When the criticism is public and hostile, the rejoinder turns into a defence, which is the aggressive side of the same reply.
senses.whyCN: 批评越公开、越尖锐，回应就越带有防守性，rejoinder 也就从普通的反驳滑向「为自己辩解」的防守性回答。

intro.en: Rejoinder comes from Old French rejoindre, to join again, and the legal profession gave it its precise judicial meaning.
intro.cn: rejoinder 来自古法语 rejoindre（重新接合），法律行业又赋予了它精确的司法含义。

items.en: The verb joins the Latin root iungere, to join, whose participle iunctus gives words such as junction and juncture.
items.cn: 这个词出自拉丁语词根 iungere（接合），它的分词 iunctus 还派生出 junction、juncture 等词。

items.en: Old French formed rejoindre with re- again plus joindre, to join, meaning “to join again”.
items.cn: 古法语用 re-（再次）加 joindre（接合）构成 rejoindre，意为「重新接合」。

items.en: English took over rejoindre and the verb rejoin, while the noun had two rival spellings, rejoinder and rejoindure.
items.cn: 英语借入动词 rejoindre 与 rejoin；名词一度有 rejoinder 与 rejoindure 两种拼写法互相竞争。

items.en: In common-law pleading the defendant reply to a replication was named the rejoinder, and from law the word spread into general speech.
items.cn: 在普通法诉答程序中，被告对原告答辩的再答复被称为 rejoinder，这个词随之从法律用语扩散到一般言语。

items.en: The legal spelling rejoinder won out, and the noun also came to mean any answer or retort in ordinary conversation.
items.cn: 十六世纪起，法律文书里的拼法 rejoinder 胜出，这个名词也开始泛指日常对话中的任何回答或回嘴。

items.en: Today the legal procedure sense is technical and specialised, while the general sense of a sharp reply remains common.
items.cn: 今天，程序意义上的法律用法已成为专业术语，而「尖锐反驳」这一一般义仍然很常用。

note.en: Rejoinder is an answer that joins onto what was said; it is near retort and reply, and looks like rejoin, return and rejoicing.
note.cn: rejoinder 是「接上」对方话头的回答，与 retort、reply 相近，拼写上又容易与 rejoin、return 和 rejoicing 混淆。

entries.definition: to answer, or to join again
entries.definitionCN: 派生词根：义为回答；反驳，也有「重新加入」之意，是 rejoinder 的动词

entries.definition: to go back or give back
entries.definitionCN: 同前缀但词源不同：re- 相同，词根来自拉丁语转义，与「接合」无关

entries.definition: the act of being glad
entries.definitionCN: 只是拼写相近，词源不同：它来自表示「快乐」的动词，与「回答」无关

entries.definition: a quick, angry or sharp reply
entries.definitionCN: 近义：迅速而带怒气的回嘴，语气比 rejoinder 更冲

entries.definition: something said or written in answer
entries.definitionCN: 近义：中性的回答，既可以指口头也可以指书面

entries.definition: a quick and clever reply, from fencing
entries.definitionCN: 近义：源于击剑的「快而巧的回击」，与 rejoinder 的机敏义最接近

normalIntro.en: Rejoinder is the answer joined onto the previous remark: re- back plus the iungere root meaning join.
normalIntro.cn: rejoinder 是「接」在上句话后面的回答：re- 表示回，词根 iungere 表示接合。

normal.en: The join- part, seen in adjoin and conjoin, means to be joined.
normal.cn: 中间的 join- 与 adjoin、conjoin 同源，都表示「接合」。

normal.en: Rejoin means to answer, and rejoinder is the noun built on it.
normal.cn: rejoin 是「回答」的动词，rejoinder 是在它之上构成的名词。

normal.en: A sharp rejoinder is a crisp come-back in a debate.
normal.cn: a sharp rejoinder 就是辩论中一句干脆的回击。

normal.en: In law, the rejoinder is the defendant formal answer.
normal.cn: 在法律里，rejoinder 指被告的正式答辩，是有明确程序位置的文书。

normal.en: Watch the -er ending: it marks the thing that answers, not the person answering.
normal.cn: 注意末尾的 -er：这里指「回答这件事」，而不是「回答的人」。

abstract.en: Picture two chess players, one moving instantly after the other.
abstract.cn: 想象两位棋手，一方落子后另一方立刻应招。

abstract.en: Picture a court file where each sheet answers the one above it.
abstract.cn: 想象一份法院卷宗，每一页都在回答它上面那页。

abstract.en: Picture words being handed back like a ball returned across the net.
abstract.cn: 想象话像球一样越过网子被打了回去。

examples.en: The debate ended with a sharp rejoinder from the young lawyer.
examples.cn: 辩论以年轻律师一句尖锐的反驳收尾。

examples.en: She met the criticism with a calm rejoinder about the facts.
examples.cn: 她面对批评，平静地就事实作了回应。

examples.en: In the pleadings, the rejoinder was filed two weeks later.
examples.cn: 在诉答文书中，被告答辩状于两周后提交。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞觉因德」——想象对方话音刚落，你立刻「接」上一句，像把球接回场内；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 iungere（接合）→ 古法语 joindre 加前缀 re- 构成 rejoindre（重新接合）→ 英语动词 rejoin（回答）与名词 rejoinder，核心义「接上对方的话作答」。

sensesIntro.en: Rejoinder is an answer joined to the remark before it: it starts as a sharp reply, becomes a formal answer in law, and widens to any response in an exchange.
sensesIntro.cn: rejoinder 是接在前面那句话之后的回答：起初指尖锐的反驳，在法律里成为正式答辩，最后泛指任何一来一往中的答复。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two speakers face to face, the second one joining an answer onto the first remark.
core.cn: 核心意象：两人面对面，第二个人把回答「接」到第一句话上。

branches.en: The conversational core: a quick and sometimes witty answer that keeps the exchange moving.
branches.cn: 对话核心：迅速、常带机锋的回答，让交谈继续下去。

branches.en: Law takes the joining step by step, so the reverbs answer becomes a named stage of written pleas.
branches.cn: 法律把接续的每一步都固定下来，于是「回答」成了书面诉答中一个有名字的阶段。

branches.en: Written and diplomatic exchanges use the word for formal replies in letters and talks.
branches.cn: 书面与外交往来也用这个词，指信件与谈判中的正式答复。

branches.en: Rhetoric makes the joining literal: the speaker picks up the earlier words and hands them back.
branches.cn: 修辞把「接」变成字面操作：说话人接过前一个人的话，再原样送回去。

branches.en: When the answer is made under attack, the reply becomes a defence of the self.
branches.cn: 当回答是在受攻击时作出的，反驳就变成了自我辩护。

intro.en: Rejoinder is built on the join root: re- plus iungere, with a noun later formed in English without the -ing.
intro.cn: rejoinder 建立在「接合」词根上：re- 加 iungere，后来英语构成的这个名词不带 -ing 后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin iungere means to join, and its participle iunctus is behind junction and juncture.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 iungere 意为接合，它的分词 iunctus 是 junction、juncture 的来源。

items.example: Re- marks the answering movement.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 标出「回答」的往返动作。

items.example: Iungere gives the joining image of the answer.
items.exampleCN: iungere 提供了回答「接合」的意象。

items.example: Iunctus also produced junction.
items.exampleCN: iunctus 也造就了 junction。

items.example: Joindre carries the root into French.
items.exampleCN: joindre 把词根带进了法语。

items.example: Rejoin names the act of answering.
items.exampleCN: rejoin 指「回答」这一动作。

items.example: Rejoinder is the noun of the reply itself.
items.exampleCN: rejoinder 指回答这件事本身。

items.meaning: the one or the thing that does
items.meaningCN: 表示施事的人或物的后缀
items.example: In this word -er names the reply, not a person.
items.exampleCN: 在这个词里，-er 指回答，而非指人。

items.example: The prefix ad- gives adjacent.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 ad- 构成 adjacent。

items.example: The prefix con- gives conjunction.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 con- 构成 conjunction。

derivatives.zh: 回答；反驳
